            with self.workspace.exports.download(applied["events_export"]["job_id"], original) as (stream, descriptor):
                body = stream.read()
            need(len(body) == descriptor["bytes"] and sha(body) == descriptor["sha256"],
                 "The original complete typed event table changed.")
            publish(name, body)
        for path, name in zip(self.source_paths(applied["accepted"]),
                              ("Original_events.ndjson", "Original_events.ndjson.manifest.json")):
            publish(name, regular(path))
        publish("Reviewed_customer_window.json", encoded(operation["review"]))
        publish("Customer_programme.json", encoded(plan["workspace_programme"]))
        for original, name in (("workspace.zip", "Event_Analysis_Workspace.zip"),
                               ("archive-manifest.json", "Event_Analysis_Workspace_Manifest.json")):
            publish(name, archive_files[original][0])
        guide = """# Continue the customer's acquired event analysis

Open Event_Report.html for the selected report and Event_Analysis.xlsx for the
reviewed workbook. Complete_Event_Table.jsonl and Complete_Event_Table.csv
contain every acquired event, with the native typed-export manifest alongside.
Original_events.ndjson and its manifest preserve the original acquired files,
including all event identities and original paid-page references.

Payload values remain text. Adjacent state columns distinguish missing, null
and JSON kinds. Event counts describe acquired events. Use the original buyer
journal and retained page outcome references to account for purchases.

Event_Analysis_Delivery.json identifies both the selected result edition and
the programme edition inside the complete workspace snapshot. A late delivery
of an older result can contain a newer complete workspace, including all prior
windows and current saved customer work. Customer_programme.json is extracted
from that exact archived SQLite snapshot. Repeating this delivery keeps the
same archive, programme and complete result, even after current work advances.

Restore Event_Analysis_Workspace.zip through the original
stellar_forge_buyer.workspace_archive_receive receiver using its SHA-256 from
Event_Analysis_Delivery.json. Open the received directory with the normal
Analysis application to continue Sources, SQL, reports and Workbooks.

The archive retains applied programme history and all source documents; the
sender's final delivery journal is recorded after its snapshot. Continue the
accepted programme using a new operation ID for a later acquired window.
Keep the same programme name and review the complete new source before applying
its exact review digest. Customer report and worksheet edits remain selected.

The publisher's private source state and the buyer's financial operations use
their original owner-operated handovers and recovery journals.
"""
        publish("Open_and_use.md", guide.encode())
        result = {"schema": "stellar-forge.event-feed-analysis-delivery.v1",
                  "programme": self.name, "operation_id": operation_id,
                  "accepted_operation_id": accepted_operation_id,
                  "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity,
                  "edition_id": applied["accepted"]["edition_id"],
                  "review_sha256": applied["accepted"]["review_sha256"],
                  "report": publication, "workbook_job_id": applied["workbook_job_id"],
                  "workspace_archive_job_id": archive["id"],
                  "workspace_programme_edition_id": archived_programme["accepted"]["edition_id"],
                  "workspace_programme_revision": archived_programme["revision"],
                  "files": list(records)}
        publish("Event_Analysis_Delivery.json", encoded(result))
        operation["delivery"] = {**result, "files": list(records), "destination": str(destination)}
        self.save_operation(operation)
        return operation["delivery"]

    def status(self):
        with self.workspace.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT id,kind,record FROM sf_analysis_event_operations WHERE programme=? ORDER BY rowid", (self.name,)).fetchall()
        return {"programme": self.programme(), "operations": [
            {"id": row["id"], "kind": row["kind"], **{
                key: value for key, value in json.loads(row["record"]).items()
                if key in {"review", "applied", "delivery", "column_choices", "prior_customer_attempts"}}} for row in rows]}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for action in ("review", "apply", "refresh-review", "deliver", "status"):
        command = commands.add_parser(action)
        command.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
        command.add_argument("--programme", required=True)
        if action != "status":
            command.add_argument("--operation-id", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true")
        if action == "review":
            command.add_argument("--ndjson", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--manifest", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--mapping")
            command.add_argument("--source-cli", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--node", default="node")
        elif action in {"apply", "refresh-review"}:
            command.add_argument("--review-sha256", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--note", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--columns", help="JSON object of worksheet index to complete reviewed column array")
        elif action == "deliver":
            command.add_argument("--destination", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--delivery-id", help="New retained delivery identity for a fresh current-workspace snapshot")
    receive = commands.add_parser("receive")
    receive.add_argument("--archive", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--sha256", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--operation-id", required=True)
    launch = commands.add_parser("serve")
    launch.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    launch.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    workspace = None
    try:
        if args.command == "receive":
            from .workspace_archive_receive import restore_archive
            result = restore_archive(args.archive, args.workspace,
                                     operation=args.operation_id, expected_sha256=args.sha256)
        else:
            workspace = AnalysisWorkspace(args.workspace)
            if args.command == "serve":
                server, control, url = serve(workspace, port=args.port)
                try:
                    print(json.dumps({"url": url, "workspace_id": workspace.identity}), flush=True)
                    server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.2)
                finally:
                    server.server_close()
                    control.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                return 0
            current = EventFeedAnalysis(workspace, args.programme,
                progress=lambda value: print(json.dumps(value), file=sys.stderr, flush=True))
            if args.command == "review":
                result = current.review(args.ndjson, args.manifest, mapping=args.mapping,
                    source_cli=args.source_cli, node=args.node,
                    operation_id=args.operation_id, resume=args.resume)
            elif args.command == "refresh-review":
                result = current.refresh_review(args.operation_id, args.review_sha256, note=args.note)
            elif args.command == "apply":
                columns = json.loads(regular(args.columns)) if args.columns else {}
                result = current.apply(args.operation_id, args.review_sha256,
                                       note=args.note, columns=columns, resume=args.resume)
            elif args.command == "deliver":
                result = current.deliver(args.operation_id, args.destination, resume=args.resume,
                                         delivery_id=args.delivery_id)
            else:
                result = current.status()
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        return 130
    except (BuyerError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"schema": SCHEMA, "error": str(error)}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        if workspace is not None:
            workspace.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Private browser operations around the original EventFeedAnalysis programme.

Exact upload chunks and action requests live in the existing workspace database.
The coordinator is outside the native Analysis executor, whose existing jobs own
imports, exports, reports, workbooks and whole-workspace archives.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64
import binascii
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
from .errors import StateError

CHUNK = 256 * 1024
LIMITS = {"ndjson": 32 * 1024 * 1024, "manifest": 4 * 1024 * 1024}
ID = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{32}")
HASH = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{64}")
NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,23}")


def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise StateError("EVENT_PROGRAMME_" + message)


def identifier(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and ID.fullmatch(value), "ORIGINAL_ID_REQUIRED")
    return value


def name(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and NAME.fullmatch(value), "NAME_REQUIRED")
    return value


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def raw(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                      allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))


class EventProgrammes:
    def __init__(self, workspace, *, source_cli=None):
        self.workspace, self.database = workspace, workspace.database
        self.source_cli = Path(source_cli).expanduser().absolute() if source_cli else (
            Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "event-feed" / "analysis-source-cli.mjs")
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._active = None
        self._closed = False
        with self.database._connection() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_event_browser_inputs(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL)")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_event_browser_chunks(input_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,offset INTEGER NOT NULL,body BLOB NOT NULL,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(input_id,kind,offset))")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_event_browser_actions(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,programme TEXT NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL)")
            for row in db.execute("SELECT id,record FROM sf_event_browser_actions").fetchall():
                value = json.loads(row["record"])
                if value["status"] == "RUNNING":
                    value.update(status="INTERRUPTED", updated_at=now(),
                                 error="Continue this original saved action.")
                    db.execute("UPDATE sf_event_browser_actions SET record=? WHERE id=?", (raw(value), row["id"]))
            db.commit()
        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="event-programmes")

    def close(self):
        with self._lock:
            self._closed = True
        self._executor.shutdown(wait=True)

    def _core(self, programme, *, progress=None):
        # Lazy import avoids a cycle through AnalysisWorkspace at package startup.
        from .event_feed_analysis import EventFeedAnalysis
        return EventFeedAnalysis(self.workspace, name(programme), progress=progress)

    def _input(self, db, input_id):
        row = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_event_browser_inputs WHERE id=?", (identifier(input_id),)).fetchone()
        need(row is not None, "INPUT_NOT_FOUND")
        return json.loads(row[0])

    def create_input(self, body):
        input_id = identifier(body.get("id"))
        files = body.get("files")
        need(isinstance(files, dict) and set(files) == set(LIMITS), "BOTH_ORIGINAL_FILES_REQUIRED")
        selected = {}
        for kind, maximum in LIMITS.items():
            item = files[kind]
            need(isinstance(item, dict) and type(item.get("bytes")) is int and
                 0 <= item["bytes"] <= maximum and
                 isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) and HASH.fullmatch(item["sha256"]), "FILE_IDENTITY_INVALID")
            label = item.get("name")
            need(isinstance(label, str) and 0 < len(label) <= 240 and not any(ord(c) < 32 for c in label),
                 "FILE_LABEL_INVALID")
            selected[kind] = {"name": label, "bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]}
        value = {"id": input_id, "files": selected, "created_at": now()}
        with self._lock, self.database._connection() as db:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            old = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_event_browser_inputs WHERE id=?", (input_id,)).fetchone()
            if old:
                need(json.loads(old[0])["files"] == selected, "INPUT_ID_REUSED")
            else:
                db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_event_browser_inputs(id,record) VALUES(?,?)", (input_id, raw(value)))
            db.commit()
        return self.input_status(input_id)

    def input_status(self, input_id):
        from .event_feed_analysis import sha
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            value = self._input(db, input_id)
            received = {}
            for kind, item in value["files"].items():
                count = db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(body)),0) FROM sf_event_browser_chunks WHERE input_id=? AND kind=?", (input_id, kind)).fetchone()[0]
                need(count <= item["bytes"], "RECEIVING_SIZE_CHANGED")
                received[kind] = count
        return {**value, "received": received, "complete": all(received[k] == v["bytes"] for k, v in value["files"].items()),
                "chunk_bytes": CHUNK, "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity}

    def chunk(self, input_id, kind, body):
        from .event_feed_analysis import sha
        need(kind in LIMITS, "FILE_KIND_INVALID")
        offset = body.get("offset")
        need(type(offset) is int and offset >= 0, "OFFSET_REQUIRED")
        try:
            binary = base64.b64decode(body.get("base64", ""), validate=True)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, binascii.Error):
            raise StateError("EVENT_PROGRAMME_CHUNK_ENCODING_INVALID") from None
        need(0 < len(binary) <= CHUNK and sha(binary) == body.get("sha256"), "CHUNK_CHANGED")
        with self._lock, self.database._connection() as db:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            value = self._input(db, input_id)
            old = db.execute("SELECT body,sha256 FROM sf_event_browser_chunks WHERE input_id=? AND kind=? AND offset=?", (input_id, kind, offset)).fetchone()
            if old:
                need(old["body"] == binary and old["sha256"] == body["sha256"], "ORIGINAL_CHUNK_REQUIRED")
            else:
                received = db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(body)),0) FROM sf_event_browser_chunks WHERE input_id=? AND kind=?", (input_id, kind)).fetchone()[0]
                need(offset == received and received + len(binary) <= value["files"][kind]["bytes"],
                     "CONTIGUOUS_ORIGINAL_CHUNK_REQUIRED")
                db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_event_browser_chunks VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", (input_id, kind, offset, binary, body["sha256"]))
            db.commit()
        return self.input_status(input_id)

    def _originals(self, input_id):
        from .event_feed_analysis import sha
        result = {}
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            value = self._input(db, input_id)
            for kind, item in value["files"].items():
                pieces, offset = [], 0
                for row in db.execute("SELECT offset,body,sha256 FROM sf_event_browser_chunks WHERE input_id=? AND kind=? ORDER BY offset", (input_id, kind)):
                    need(row["offset"] == offset and sha(row["body"]) == row["sha256"], "RETAINED_CHUNK_CHANGED")
                    pieces.append(row["body"])
                    offset += len(row["body"])
                content = b"".join(pieces)
                need(len(content) == item["bytes"] and sha(content) == item["sha256"], "COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_FILE_REQUIRED")
                result[kind] = content
        return result

    def inspect_input(self, input_id, *, pointer=None, offset=0, limit=25):
        """Read complete original payloads through the trusted installed receiver."""
        input_id = identifier(input_id)
        need(pointer is None or isinstance(pointer, str) and len(pointer) <= 2000,
             "PAYLOAD_POINTER_REQUIRED")
        need(type(offset) is int and offset >= 0 and type(limit) is int and 1 <= limit <= 100,
             "FIELD_PAGE_INVALID")
        with self._lock:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            future = self._executor.submit(self._inspect_input, input_id, pointer, offset, limit)
        return future.result()

    def _inspect_input(self, input_id, pointer, offset, limit):
        from .event_feed_analysis import exact_file, regular, sha
        originals = self._originals(input_id)
        source_cli = self.source_cli.resolve(strict=True)
        source_core = source_cli.with_name("analysis-source.mjs")
        need(source_cli.name == "analysis-source-cli.mjs" and source_core.is_file(),
             "ORIGINAL_SOURCE_RECEIVER_REQUIRED")
        cli_raw, core_raw = regular(source_cli), regular(source_core)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="event-payload-inspection-") as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            for name_, content in (("analysis-source-cli.mjs", cli_raw), ("analysis-source.mjs", core_raw),
                                   ("events.ndjson", originals["ndjson"]), ("manifest.json", originals["manifest"])):
                exact_file(root / name_, content)
            args = [self.workspace.node, str(root / "analysis-source-cli.mjs"),
                    "--ndjson", str(root / "events.ndjson"), "--manifest", str(root / "manifest.json")]
            args += (["--inspect-fields", "true"] if pointer is None else
                     ["--field-values", pointer, "--offset", str(offset), "--limit", str(limit)])
            completed = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, check=False, timeout=120)
        need(completed.returncode == 0,
             completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:8000] or "SOURCE_INSPECTION_FAILED")
        need(0 < len(completed.stdout) <= 49 * 1024 * 1024, "SOURCE_INSPECTION_TOO_LARGE")
        result = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        expected = "stellar-forge.event-feed-payload-" + ("fields" if pointer is None else "values") + ".v1"
        need(result.get("schema") == expected and
             result.get("original_files") == {kind: {"bytes": len(value), "sha256": sha(value)}
                                               for kind, value in originals.items()},
             "SOURCE_INSPECTION_CHANGED")
        if pointer is not None:
            need(result.get("pointer") == pointer and result.get("offset") == offset and result.get("limit") == limit,
                 "SOURCE_INSPECTION_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        return {**result, "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity, "input_id": input_id,
                "receiver": {"cli_sha256": sha(cli_raw), "core_sha256": sha(core_raw)}}


    def compare_mapping(self, programme, input_id, mapping):
        """Read the original accepted source and the exact proposed received pair."""
        programme, input_id = name(programme), identifier(input_id)
        need(isinstance(mapping, dict) and isinstance(mapping.get("fields"), list) and
             len(mapping["fields"]) <= 100 and len(raw(mapping).encode()) <= 1024 * 1024,
             "FIELD_MAPPING_REQUIRED")
        with self._lock:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            future = self._executor.submit(self._compare_mapping, programme, input_id, mapping)
        return future.result()

    def _compare_mapping(self, programme, input_id, mapping):
        from .event_feed_analysis import exact_file, regular, sha
        core = self._core(programme)
        baseline = core.programme()
        accepted = baseline["accepted"]
        need(accepted is not None, "ACCEPTED_MAPPING_REQUIRED")
        previous_paths = core.source_paths(accepted)
        previous = {kind: regular(path, LIMITS[kind]) for kind, path in
                    zip(("ndjson", "manifest"), previous_paths)}
        current = self._originals(input_id)
        source_cli = self.source_cli.resolve(strict=True)
        source_core = source_cli.with_name("analysis-source.mjs")
        need(source_cli.name == "analysis-source-cli.mjs" and source_core.is_file(),
             "ORIGINAL_SOURCE_RECEIVER_REQUIRED")
        cli_raw, core_raw = regular(source_cli), regular(source_core)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="event-mapping-comparison-") as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            selected = {"analysis-source-cli.mjs": cli_raw, "analysis-source.mjs": core_raw,
                        "events.ndjson": current["ndjson"], "manifest.json": current["manifest"],
                        "previous.ndjson": previous["ndjson"], "previous.json": previous["manifest"],
                        "mapping.json": raw(mapping).encode(),
                        "previous-mapping.json": raw(accepted["mapping"]).encode()}
            for filename, content in selected.items():
                exact_file(root / filename, content)
            command = [self.workspace.node, str(root / "analysis-source-cli.mjs"),
                       "--ndjson", str(root / "events.ndjson"), "--manifest", str(root / "manifest.json"),
                       "--previous-ndjson", str(root / "previous.ndjson"),
                       "--previous-manifest", str(root / "previous.json"),
                       "--mapping", str(root / "mapping.json"),
                       "--previous-mapping", str(root / "previous-mapping.json"),
                       "--compare-mapping", "true"]
            completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, check=False, timeout=120)
        need(completed.returncode == 0,
             completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:8000] or "MAPPING_COMPARISON_FAILED")
        need(0 < len(completed.stdout) <= 25 * 1024 * 1024, "MAPPING_COMPARISON_TOO_LARGE")
        result = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        need(result.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.event-feed-mapping-comparison.v1" and
             HASH.fullmatch(result.get("comparison_sha256", "")), "MAPPING_COMPARISON_CHANGED")
        for key, originals in (("previous", previous), ("current", current)):
            need(result.get(key, {}).get("original_files") ==
                 {kind: {"bytes": len(value), "sha256": sha(value)} for kind, value in originals.items()},
                 "MAPPING_COMPARISON_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        need(result["previous"]["edition_id"] == accepted["edition_id"] and
             result["previous_mapping"] == accepted["mapping"] and
             result["previous_mapping_sha256"] == accepted["mapping_sha256"],
             "ORIGINAL_ACCEPTED_MAPPING_CHANGED")
        need(core.programme()["revision"] == baseline["revision"], "MAPPING_BASELINE_CHANGED")
        return {**result, "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity, "programme": programme,
                "programme_revision": baseline["revision"], "input_id": input_id,
                "baseline_operation_id": accepted["operation_id"],
                "receiver": {"cli_sha256": sha(cli_raw), "core_sha256": sha(core_raw)}}

    def _review_mapping(self, programme, request):
        selection = request["mapping_review"]
        need(isinstance(selection, dict) and set(selection) ==
             {"comparison_sha256", "programme_revision", "baseline_operation_id",
              "reviewer", "note", "decisions"}, "COMPLETE_MAPPING_REVIEW_REQUIRED")
        comparison = self._compare_mapping(programme, request["input_id"], request["mapping"])
        for key in ("comparison_sha256", "programme_revision", "baseline_operation_id"):
            need(selection[key] == comparison[key], "MAPPING_REVIEW_BASIS_CHANGED")
        for key, maximum in (("reviewer", 240), ("note", 8000)):
            value = selection[key]
            need(isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() and len(value.encode()) <= maximum and
                 not any(ord(char) < 32 and char not in "\n\t\r" for char in value),
                 "MAPPING_REVIEW_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED")
        decisions = selection["decisions"]
        need(isinstance(decisions, list) and len(decisions) <= 200, "MAPPING_DECISIONS_REQUIRED")
        names = []
        for decision in decisions:
            need(isinstance(decision, dict) and set(decision) == {"name", "reason"} and
                 isinstance(decision["name"], str) and isinstance(decision["reason"], str) and
                 decision["reason"].strip() and len(decision["reason"].encode()) <= 4000,
                 "MAPPING_DECISION_REASON_REQUIRED")
            names.append(decision["name"])
        need(len(names) == len(set(names)) and set(names) == set(comparison["required_decisions"]),
             "EVERY_MAPPING_CHANGE_REQUIRES_ITS_ORIGINAL_DECISION")
        return {"schema": "stellar-forge.event-mapping-review.v1", "comparison": comparison,
                "selection": selection, "reviewed_at": now()}

    def overview(self, *, actions_before=None, inputs_before=None, limit=25):
        need(type(limit) is int and 1 <= limit <= 100 and
             all(value is None or type(value) is int and value > 0 for value in (actions_before, inputs_before)), "PAGE_INVALID")
        # Initialise the original programme tables even before its first review.
        self._core("event_workspace")
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            programmes = [json.loads(r[0]) for r in db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_analysis_event_programmes ORDER BY name")]
            rows = db.execute("SELECT sequence,record FROM sf_event_browser_actions WHERE (? IS NULL OR sequence<?) ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT ?", (actions_before, actions_before, limit + 1)).fetchall()
            inputs = db.execute("SELECT sequence,record FROM sf_event_browser_inputs WHERE (? IS NULL OR sequence<?) ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT ?", (inputs_before, inputs_before, limit + 1)).fetchall()
        # Input and action pagination have distinct cursors.
        return {"workspace_id": self.workspace.identity, "active": self._active,
                "source_receiver_available": self.source_cli.is_file() and self.source_cli.with_name("analysis-source.mjs").is_file(),
                "programmes": programmes, "actions": [json.loads(r["record"]) for r in rows[:limit]],
                "next_actions": rows[limit-1]["sequence"] if len(rows)>limit else None,
                "inputs": [json.loads(r["record"]) for r in inputs[:limit]],
                "next_inputs": inputs[limit-1]["sequence"] if len(inputs)>limit else None}

    def programme(self, programme):
        return self._core(programme).status()

    def _action(self, action_id):
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_event_browser_actions WHERE id=?", (identifier(action_id),)).fetchone()
        need(row is not None, "ACTION_NOT_FOUND")
        return json.loads(row[0])

    def _store(self, value):
        value["updated_at"] = now()
        with self.database._connection() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE sf_event_browser_actions SET record=? WHERE id=?", (raw(value), value["id"]))

    def action(self, action_id):
        return self._action(action_id)

    def start(self, programme, body):
        programme = name(programme)
        action_id = identifier(body.get("id"))
        operation_id = identifier(body.get("operation_id"))
        action = body.get("action")
        need(action in {"review", "apply", "refresh-review", "deliver"}, "ACTION_INVALID")
        request = {"action": action, "operation_id": operation_id}
        if action == "review":
            request["input_id"] = identifier(body.get("input_id"))
            mapping = body.get("mapping")
            need(isinstance(mapping, dict) and isinstance(mapping.get("fields"), list) and
                 len(mapping["fields"]) <= 100 and len(raw(mapping).encode()) <= 1024 * 1024, "FIELD_MAPPING_REQUIRED")
            request["mapping"] = mapping
            if "mapping_review" in body:
                need(isinstance(body["mapping_review"], dict) and
                     len(raw(body["mapping_review"]).encode()) <= 1024 * 1024, "MAPPING_REVIEW_INVALID")
                request["mapping_review"] = body["mapping_review"]
        if action in {"apply", "refresh-review"}:
            digest = body.get("review_sha256")
            note = body.get("note")
            need(isinstance(digest, str) and HASH.fullmatch(digest), "REVIEW_REQUIRED")
            need(isinstance(note, str) and note.strip() and len(note.encode()) <= 8000, "DECISION_NOTE_REQUIRED")
            request.update(review_sha256=digest, note=note)
            if action == "apply":
                columns = body.get("columns", {})
                need(isinstance(columns, dict) and len(raw(columns).encode()) <= 512 * 1024, "WORKBOOK_COLUMNS_INVALID")
                request["columns"] = columns
        resume = body.get("resume", False)
        need(type(resume) is bool, "RESUME_INVALID")
        with self._lock:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
                row = db.execute("SELECT programme,record FROM sf_event_browser_actions WHERE id=?", (action_id,)).fetchone()
            if row:
                value = json.loads(row["record"])
                need(row["programme"] == programme and value["request"] == request, "ACTION_ID_REUSED")
                if value["status"] in {"RUNNING", "COMPLETE"}:
                    return value
                need(resume, "EXPLICIT_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED")
            else:
                value = {"id": action_id, "programme": programme, "request": request,
                         "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity, "created_at": now(),
                         "status": "READY", "attempts": 0}
                with self.database._connection() as db:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_event_browser_actions(id,programme,record) VALUES(?,?,?)",
                               (action_id, programme, raw(value)))
            need(self._active is None, "ANOTHER_ACTION_RUNNING")
            # One browser request has one retained engine identity. Later retries
            # do not reinterpret paths, selected files or a reviewed decision.
            value.update(status="RUNNING", error=None, attempts=value["attempts"]+1)
            self._active = action_id
            self._store(value)
            try:
                self._executor.submit(self._run, action_id, resume)
            except BaseException:
                self._active = None
                value.update(status="INTERRUPTED", error="Continue the retained action.")
                self._store(value)
                raise
        return value

    def _run(self, action_id, resume):
        from .event_feed_analysis import encoded, exact_file, regular
        value = self._action(action_id)
        try:
            def progress(event):
                current = self._action(action_id)
                current["progress"] = event
                self._store(current)
            core = self._core(value["programme"], progress=progress)
            request = value["request"]
            operation = request["operation_id"]
            if request["action"] == "review":
                if "mapping_review" in request:
                    if "mapping_review" not in value:
                        value["mapping_review"] = self._review_mapping(value["programme"], request)
                        self._store(value)
                    evidence = value["mapping_review"]
                    need(evidence["selection"] == request["mapping_review"], "ORIGINAL_MAPPING_REVIEW_CHANGED")
                    with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
                        existing = db.execute("SELECT id FROM sf_analysis_event_operations WHERE id=?",
                                              (operation,)).fetchone()
                    saved = core.operation(operation) if existing else None
                    if not saved or not saved.get("review"):
                        current = core.programme()
                        need(current["revision"] == evidence["comparison"]["programme_revision"] and
                             (current["accepted"] or {}).get("operation_id") ==
                             evidence["comparison"]["baseline_operation_id"], "MAPPING_BASELINE_CHANGED")
                originals = self._originals(request["input_id"])
                # Executable source is chosen by the local launch configuration.
                # Browser inputs are data only, never an executable source path.
                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="event-browser-source-") as temporary:
                    root = Path(temporary)
                    exact_file(root / "events.ndjson", originals["ndjson"])
                    exact_file(root / "manifest.json", originals["manifest"])
                    exact_file(root / "mapping.json", encoded(request["mapping"]))
                    result = core.review(root / "events.ndjson", root / "manifest.json",
                        mapping=root / "mapping.json", source_cli=self.source_cli,
                        node=self.workspace.node, operation_id=operation, resume=resume)
                if "mapping_review" in request:
                    comparison = value["mapping_review"]["comparison"]
                    need(result["programme_revision"] == comparison["programme_revision"] and
                         result["edition_id"] == comparison["current"]["edition_id"] and
                         result["mapping_sha256"] == comparison["mapping_sha256"] and
                         result["mapping"] == comparison["mapping"] and
                         result["source"] == comparison["current"]["source"],
                         "NATIVE_MAPPING_REVIEW_BASIS_CHANGED")
            elif request["action"] == "apply":
                result = core.apply(operation, request["review_sha256"], note=request["note"],
                                    columns=request["columns"], resume=resume)
            elif request["action"] == "refresh-review":
                # A restart after core save must reopen the same refreshed review,
                # rather than append another generation to the original operation.
                saved = core.operation(operation)
                review = saved.get("review", {})
                if review.get("review_sha256") != request["review_sha256"]:
                    prior = saved.get("prior_customer_attempts", [])
                    need(prior and prior[-1]["review"]["review_sha256"] == request["review_sha256"] and
                         prior[-1]["note"] == request["note"] and
                         review.get("customer_review_note") == request["note"], "REFRESHED_REVIEW_CHANGED")
                    result = review
                else:
                    result = core.refresh_review(operation, request["review_sha256"], note=request["note"])
            else:
                # The native engine owns the immutable archive/delivery plan.
                destination = self.database.directory / "event-browser-deliveries" / action_id
                result = core.deliver(operation, destination, resume=resume, delivery_id=action_id)
            value = self._action(action_id)
            value.update(status="COMPLETE", result=result, error=None)
            self._store(value)
        except Exception as error:
            value = self._action(action_id)
            value.update(status="ERROR", error=str(error))
            self._store(value)
        finally:
            with self._lock:
                self._active = None

    def download(self, programme, operation_id, filename):
        core = self._core(programme)
        operation = core.operation(identifier(operation_id))
        delivery = operation.get("delivery")
        need(delivery is not None, "DELIVERY_REQUIRED")
        need(isinstance(filename, str) and Path(filename).name == filename, "FILE_NAME_INVALID")
        item = next((r for r in delivery["files"] if r["name"] == filename), None)
        need(item is not None, "DELIVERY_FILE_NOT_FOUND")
        # Do not follow an absolute path retained by a sender after archive restore.
        path = self.database.directory / "event-browser-deliveries" / operation_id / filename
        mime = ("application/zip" if filename.endswith(".zip") else
                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" if filename.endswith(".xlsx") else
                "text/html;charset=utf-8" if filename.endswith(".html") else
                "application/json" if filename.endswith(".json") else
                "application/x-ndjson" if filename.endswith((".jsonl", ".ndjson")) else "text/plain;charset=utf-8")
        return path, {**item, "filename": filename, "mime": mime}

"""Reviewed pairwise evidence synthesis using the installed statsmodels engine.

Original extraction descriptors and lexical values remain attached to every
included, excluded and non-estimable row. This module performs no acquisition.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import math
import platform
import re
import warnings

from .errors import StateError

PLAN_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.evidence-synthesis-plan.v1"
RESULT_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.evidence-synthesis-result.v1"
ENGINE_VERSION = "0.15.0"
MEASURES = ("RR", "OR", "RD", "MD", "SMD", "HR")
COHORT_KEYS = ("population", "outcome", "intervention", "comparator",
               "timepoint", "estimand", "unit")
_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}")
_NUMBER = re.compile(r"-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?")
_HASH = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}")
_METHOD_URL = "https://www.statsmodels.org/v0.15.0/generated/statsmodels.stats.meta_analysis.combine_effects.html"


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False,
                      sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def content_sha256(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def need(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise StateError("ANALYSIS_SYNTHESIS_" + code)


def text(value, maximum=1024):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() and len(value) <= maximum
         and all(ord(c) >= 32 and ord(c) != 127 for c in value), "TEXT_INVALID")
    return value


def identifier(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and _ID.fullmatch(value), "IDENTITY_INVALID")
    return value


def finite(value):
    need(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value), "NUMBER_INVALID")
    return float(value)


def engine_information(*, required=False):
    packages = {}
    for name in ("statsmodels", "numpy", "scipy", "matplotlib"):
        try:
            packages[name] = importlib.metadata.version(name)
        except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
            packages[name] = None
    ready = packages["statsmodels"] == ENGINE_VERSION and all(packages.values())
    if required:
        need(ready, "INSTALL_PINNED_SYNTHESIS_EXTRA")
    return {"name": "statsmodels.stats.meta_analysis",
            "required_statsmodels": ENGINE_VERSION, "ready": bool(ready),
            "packages": packages, "python": platform.python_version(),
            "source": "https://github.com/statsmodels/statsmodels/blob/v0.15.0/statsmodels/stats/meta_analysis.py",
            "methods": _METHOD_URL}


def validate_protocol(value):
    need(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") == PLAN_SCHEMA, "PLAN_FORMAT_INVALID")
    required = {"schema", "title", "question", "cohort", "measure", "mapping",
                "analysis", "selections", "reviewer", "rationale"}
    need(required <= value.keys(), "PLAN_FIELDS_REQUIRED")
    p = deepcopy(value)
    for key in ("title", "question", "rationale"):
        text(p[key], 10000 if key != "title" else 240)
    reviewer = p["reviewer"]
    need(isinstance(reviewer, dict), "REVIEWER_REQUIRED")
    identifier(reviewer.get("id")); text(reviewer.get("name"), 240)
    need(isinstance(p["cohort"], dict) and set(p["cohort"]) == set(COHORT_KEYS),
         "COMPLETE_COHORT_REQUIRED")
    for part in p["cohort"].values():
        text(part, 1000)
    need(p["measure"] in MEASURES, "MEASURE_INVALID")
    _mapping(p["mapping"], p["measure"])
    a = p["analysis"]
    need(isinstance(a, dict), "METHOD_REQUIRED")
    need(a.get("model") in {"common", "random"}, "MODEL_INVALID")
    need(a.get("tau_method") in {"pm", "dl"}, "TAU_METHOD_INVALID")
    need(a.get("interval") in {"normal", "hksj"}, "INTERVAL_INVALID")
    need(a["model"] != "common" or a["interval"] == "normal", "COMMON_NORMAL_INTERVAL_REQUIRED")
    alpha = finite(a.get("alpha"))
    need(0 < alpha < 1, "ALPHA_INVALID")
    need(a.get("continuity") in {"none", "zero-cells-0.5"}, "CONTINUITY_REQUIRED")
    need(type(a.get("allow_derived", False)) is bool, "DERIVED_SELECTION_INVALID")
    need(type(a.get("leave_one_out", True)) is bool, "SENSITIVITY_SELECTION_INVALID")
    a.setdefault("allow_derived", False); a.setdefault("leave_one_out", True)
    a.setdefault("pm_tolerance", 1e-8); a.setdefault("pm_max_iterations", 500)
    need(0 < finite(a["pm_tolerance"]) <= 1e-3, "PM_TOLERANCE_INVALID")
    need(type(a["pm_max_iterations"]) is int and 1 <= a["pm_max_iterations"] <= 100000,
         "PM_ITERATIONS_INVALID")
    selections = p["selections"]
    need(isinstance(selections, list) and len(selections) > 0, "SELECTION_REQUIRED")
    selected_ids = set()
    for item in selections:
        need(isinstance(item, dict), "RESULT_SELECTION_INVALID")
        key = (identifier(item.get("result_id")), identifier(item.get("edition_id")))
        need(key not in selected_ids, "RESULT_SELECTED_TWICE"); selected_ids.add(key)
        need(type(item.get("include")) is bool, "INCLUSION_DECISION_REQUIRED")
        text(item.get("reason"), 10000)
        need(isinstance(item.get("descriptor_sha256"), str)
             and _HASH.fullmatch(item["descriptor_sha256"]), "REVIEWED_DESCRIPTOR_REQUIRED")
        if item["include"]:
            need(item.get("cohort") == p["cohort"], "COMPARABILITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED")
            need(item.get("independence") in {"independent-groups", "reported-adjusted-estimate"},
                 "INDEPENDENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED")
            need(item.get("orientation") in {"as-selected", "reverse"}, "ORIENTATION_REQUIRED")
            if "mapping" in item:
                _mapping(item["mapping"], p["measure"])
        if "subgroups" in item:
            need(isinstance(item["subgroups"], dict), "SUBGROUP_VALUES_INVALID")
            for key, part in item["subgroups"].items():
                identifier(key); text(part, 1000)
    groups = p.setdefault("subgroups", [])
    need(isinstance(groups, list), "SUBGROUPS_INVALID")
    seen = set()
    for group in groups:
        need(isinstance(group, dict), "SUBGROUP_INVALID")
        identifier(group.get("id")); text(group.get("label"), 240)
        text(group.get("rationale"), 10000)
        need(group["id"] not in seen, "SUBGROUP_DUPLICATED"); seen.add(group["id"])
    sets = p.setdefault("sensitivity_sets", [])
    need(isinstance(sets, list), "SENSITIVITY_SETS_INVALID")
    seen = set()
    for item in sets:
        need(isinstance(item, dict), "SENSITIVITY_SET_INVALID")
        identifier(item.get("id")); text(item.get("label"), 240); text(item.get("reason"), 10000)
        need(item["id"] not in seen, "SENSITIVITY_DUPLICATED"); seen.add(item["id"])
        need(isinstance(item.get("omit_result_ids"), list), "OMIT_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
        for key in item["omit_result_ids"]:
            identifier(key)
    return p


def _mapping(mapping, measure):
    need(isinstance(mapping, dict), "EFFECT_MAPPING_REQUIRED")
    kind = mapping.get("kind")
    expected = {
        "binary": {"events_t", "total_t", "events_c", "total_c"},
        "continuous": {"mean_t", "sd_t", "total_t", "mean_c", "sd_c", "total_c"},
        "estimate-se": {"estimate", "se"},
        "estimate-ci": {"estimate", "lower", "upper"},
    }
    need(kind in expected, "EFFECT_MAPPING_INVALID")
    fields = mapping.get("fields")
    need(isinstance(fields, dict) and set(fields) == expected[kind], "MAPPED_FIELDS_INVALID")
    for selector in fields.values():
        _selector(selector)
    need(kind != "binary" or measure in {"RR", "OR", "RD"}, "BINARY_MEASURE_INVALID")
    need(kind != "continuous" or measure in {"MD", "SMD"}, "CONTINUOUS_MEASURE_INVALID")
    if kind in {"estimate-se", "estimate-ci"}:
        need(mapping.get("reported_scale") in {"analysis", "display"}, "REPORTED_SCALE_REQUIRED")
        if kind == "estimate-se" and measure in {"RR", "OR", "HR"}:
            need(mapping["reported_scale"] == "analysis", "RATIO_STANDARD_ERROR_MUST_BE_LOG_SCALE")
        if kind == "estimate-ci":
            need(0 < finite(mapping.get("confidence_level")) < 1, "SOURCE_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL_REQUIRED")
            need(mapping.get("distribution") in {"normal", "t"}, "SOURCE_INTERVAL_DISTRIBUTION_REQUIRED")
            if mapping["distribution"] == "t":
                need(finite(mapping.get("degrees_of_freedom")) > 0, "SOURCE_INTERVAL_DF_REQUIRED")
    return mapping


def _selector(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        identifier(value)
        return
    need(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {"sum"}
         and isinstance(value["sum"], list) and len(value["sum"]) >= 2,
         "SOURCE_FIELD_SELECTOR_INVALID")
    for item in value["sum"]:
        identifier(item)


def _lexical_number(value):
    if type(value) in (int, float):
        need(math.isfinite(value), "FINITE_REPORTED_NUMBER_REQUIRED")
        value = json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False)
    need(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) <= 256 and _NUMBER.fullmatch(value),
         "REPORTED_NUMERIC_VALUE_REQUIRED")
    try:
        number = Decimal(value)
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise StateError("ANALYSIS_SYNTHESIS_REPORTED_NUMERIC_VALUE_REQUIRED") from None
    need(number.is_finite(), "FINITE_REPORTED_NUMBER_REQUIRED")
    return number


def source_number(record, selector, *, allow_derived):
    """Read accepted numeric fields without changing their original source tags."""
    fields = [selector] if isinstance(selector, str) else selector["sum"]
    form = record.get("form")
    definition = form.get("definition") if isinstance(form, dict) else None
    defined = definition.get("fields") if isinstance(definition, dict) else None
    field_definitions = {item.get("id"): item for item in defined if isinstance(item, dict)} if isinstance(defined, list) else {}
    operands, values = [], []
    for field in fields:
        answer = record.get("values", {}).get(field)
        need(isinstance(answer, dict), "REPORTED_FIELD_REQUIRED")
        status = answer.get("status")
        need(status == "reported" or status == "derived" and allow_derived,
             "VALUE_" + str(status or "MISSING").upper().replace("-", "_"))
        value = answer.get("value")
        need(isinstance(value, list) and len(value) == 2 and value[0] in {"number", "str"},
             "REPORTED_NUMERIC_VALUE_REQUIRED")
        field_definition = field_definitions.get(field, {})
        # Original Research integer/decimal fields preserve a JSON string source
        # as ["str", lexical]. The declared native field type authorizes parsing;
        # a numeric-looking text or identifier field is never silently coerced.
        need(value[0] == "number" or field_definition.get("valueType") in {"integer", "decimal"},
             "LEXICAL_NUMERIC_FIELD_REQUIRED")
        numeric = _lexical_number(value[1])
        operands.append({"field": field, "field_value_type": field_definition.get("valueType"),
                         "answer": deepcopy(answer)})
        values.append(numeric)
    number = sum(values, Decimal(0))
    f = float(number)
    need(math.isfinite(f), "NUMBER_OUTSIDE_ENGINE_RANGE")
    return f, {"selector": deepcopy(selector), "operands": operands,
               "transformation": "identity" if isinstance(selector, str) else "exact-decimal-sum",
               "lexical": str(number)}


def _display(value, measure):
    if value is None:
        return None
    if measure in {"RR", "OR", "HR"}:
        try:
            out = math.exp(value)
        except OverflowError:
            return None
        return out if math.isfinite(out) and out > 0 else None
    return value


def _interval(mean, se, alpha, *, df=None):
    from scipy import stats
    critical = float(stats.norm.isf(alpha / 2) if df is None else stats.t.isf(alpha / 2, df))
    return [float(mean - critical * se), float(mean + critical * se)]


def _row_effect(record, choice, p):
    import numpy as np
    from scipy import stats
    from statsmodels.stats.meta_analysis import effectsize_2proportions, effectsize_smd

    mapping = choice.get("mapping", p["mapping"])
    kind, measure = mapping["kind"], p["measure"]
    need(kind in {"estimate-se", "estimate-ci"} or choice["independence"] == "independent-groups",
         "ADJUSTED_ESTIMATE_REQUIRED_FOR_DEPENDENT_DESIGN")
    values, provenance = {}, {}
    for name, selector in mapping["fields"].items():
        values[name], provenance[name] = source_number(
            record, selector, allow_derived=p["analysis"]["allow_derived"])
    correction = None
    method = None
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as observed:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        if kind == "binary":
            a, n1, c, n2 = (values[k] for k in ("events_t", "total_t", "events_c", "total_c"))
            need(all(v.is_integer() for v in (a, n1, c, n2)) and n1 > 0 and n2 > 0
                 and 0 <= a <= n1 and 0 <= c <= n2 and max(n1, n2) <= 2**53, "BINARY_COUNTS_INVALID")
            zero = a in {0, n1} or c in {0, n2}
            if measure in {"RR", "OR"} and ((a == c == 0) or (a == n1 and c == n2)):
                raise StateError("ANALYSIS_SYNTHESIS_NO_RELATIVE_EFFECT_INFORMATION")
            if zero and p["analysis"]["continuity"] == "zero-cells-0.5":
                correction = 0.5
            need(measure == "RD" or not zero or correction is not None,
                 "ZERO_CELL_REQUIRES_SELECTED_METHOD")
            # The native float correction modifies every supplied numerator.
            # This one-study call supplies it only for an actual zero-cell row.
            effect, variance = effectsize_2proportions(
                np.array([a]), np.array([n1]), np.array([c]), np.array([n2]),
                statistic={"RR": "rr", "OR": "or", "RD": "diff"}[measure],
                zero_correction=correction)
            yi, vi = float(effect[0]), float(variance[0])
            method = "statsmodels.effectsize_2proportions"
        elif kind == "continuous":
            m1, s1, n1, m2, s2, n2 = (
                values[k] for k in ("mean_t", "sd_t", "total_t", "mean_c", "sd_c", "total_c"))
            need(n1.is_integer() and n2.is_integer() and n1 >= 2 and n2 >= 2
                 and s1 >= 0 and s2 >= 0, "CONTINUOUS_SUMMARIES_INVALID")
            if measure == "SMD":
                need(s1 > 0 or s2 > 0, "POOLED_STANDARD_DEVIATION_ZERO")
                effect, variance = effectsize_smd(
                    np.array([m1]), np.array([s1]), np.array([n1]),
                    np.array([m2]), np.array([s2]), np.array([n2]))
                yi, vi = float(effect[0]), float(variance[0])
                method = "statsmodels.effectsize_smd; bias-corrected standardized mean difference"
            else:
                yi, vi = m1 - m2, s1 * s1 / n1 + s2 * s2 / n2
                method = "independent mean difference; reported arm SD squared / n"
        elif kind == "estimate-se":
            yi, se = values["estimate"], values["se"]
            need(se > 0, "POSITIVE_STANDARD_ERROR_REQUIRED")
            vi = se * se
            method = "reported estimate and standard error on analysis scale"
        else:
            yi, lo, hi = (values[k] for k in ("estimate", "lower", "upper"))
            if mapping["reported_scale"] == "display" and measure in {"RR", "OR", "HR"}:
                need(min(yi, lo, hi) > 0, "POSITIVE_RATIO_INTERVAL_REQUIRED")
                yi, lo, hi = math.log(yi), math.log(lo), math.log(hi)
            need(lo < yi < hi, "SOURCE_CONFIDENCE_INTERVAL_INVALID")
            need(abs((yi - lo) - (hi - yi)) <= max(1e-8, abs(hi - lo) * 0.01),
                 "ASYMMETRIC_INTERVAL_REQUIRES_REPORTED_STANDARD_ERROR")
            alpha = 1 - mapping["confidence_level"]
            critical = float(stats.norm.isf(alpha / 2) if mapping["distribution"] == "normal"
                             else stats.t.isf(alpha / 2, mapping["degrees_of_freedom"]))
            se = (hi - lo) / (2 * critical)
            vi = se * se
            method = "reported symmetric interval inverted on analysis scale"
        need(math.isfinite(yi) and math.isfinite(vi) and vi > 0, "EFFECT_NOT_ESTIMABLE")
        if choice["orientation"] == "reverse":
            yi = -yi
        se = math.sqrt(vi)
        ci = _interval(yi, se, p["analysis"]["alpha"])
    return {
        "estimate": yi, "variance": vi, "standard_error": se, "interval": ci,
        "display_estimate": _display(yi, measure),
        "display_interval": [_display(v, measure) for v in ci],
        "measure": measure, "analysis_scale": "log" if measure in {"RR", "OR", "HR"} else "identity",
        "orientation": choice["orientation"], "method": method,
        "continuity_correction": correction, "numbers": provenance,
        "warnings": sorted({str(w.message) for w in observed}),
    }


def descriptors_index(descriptors):
    need(isinstance(descriptors, list), "PUBLICATION_RESULTS_REQUIRED")
    indexed = {}
    for item in descriptors:
        need(isinstance(item, dict), "RESULT_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
        key = (identifier(item.get("resultId")), identifier(item.get("editionId")))
        need(key not in indexed, "PUBLICATION_RESULT_DUPLICATED")
        need(isinstance(item.get("record"), dict) and isinstance(item.get("sourceBindings"), list),
             "FULL_SOURCE_BOUND_DESCRIPTOR_REQUIRED")
        indexed[key] = item
    return indexed


def review(protocol, descriptors, *, compute_effects=False, cancelled=lambda: None):
    p = validate_protocol(protocol)
    originals = descriptors_index(descriptors)
    if compute_effects:
        engine_information(required=True)
    rows, selected, studies = [], set(), {}
    for choice in p["selections"]:
        cancelled()
        key = (choice["result_id"], choice["edition_id"])
        need(key in originals, "SELECTED_RESULT_NOT_IN_PUBLICATION")
        original = originals[key]
        need(content_sha256(original) == choice["descriptor_sha256"], "REVIEWED_RESULT_CHANGED")
        selected.add(key)
        study = original["record"].get("study", {})
        study_id = original.get("studyId") or study.get("id")
        need(isinstance(study_id, str) and study_id, "ORIGINAL_STUDY_ID_REQUIRED")
        row = {
            "result_id": key[0], "edition_id": key[1], "study_id": study_id,
            "study_version": study.get("version"), "label": original.get("label", key[0]),
            "descriptor_sha256": choice["descriptor_sha256"],
            "source_status": original.get("status"), "source_current": original.get("current"),
            "decision": deepcopy(choice), "source_bindings": deepcopy(original["sourceBindings"]),
            "state": "EXCLUDED" if not choice["include"] else "SELECTED",
            "reason": choice["reason"], "issues": [], "effect": None,
        }
        if choice["include"]:
            if original.get("status") != "RESOLVED" or original["record"].get("status") != "RESOLVED":
                row["state"] = "UNRESOLVED"
                row["issues"].append("Only the original resolved result edition is eligible for pooling.")
            elif not original["sourceBindings"]:
                row["state"] = "NON_ESTIMABLE"
                row["issues"].append("The selected original result has no retained source binding.")
            elif compute_effects:
                try:
                    row["effect"] = _row_effect(original["record"], choice, p)
                    row["state"] = "ESTIMABLE"
                except StateError as error:
                    row["state"] = "NON_ESTIMABLE"
                    row["issues"].append(error.code.removeprefix("ANALYSIS_SYNTHESIS_"))
            studies.setdefault(study_id, []).append(row)
        rows.append(row)
    conflicts = []
    for study_id, members in studies.items():
        if len(members) > 1:
            conflicts.append({"study_id": study_id, "result_ids": [r["result_id"] for r in members],
                              "reason": "Select one independent result per study for this contrast."})
            for row in members:
                row["state"] = "DEPENDENT_SELECTION"
                row["issues"].append("Another included result belongs to this original study.")
    excluded = [{"result_id": k[0], "edition_id": k[1], "study_id": v.get("studyId"),
                 "label": v.get("label"), "source_status": v.get("status"),
                 "state": "UNSELECTED", "descriptor_sha256": content_sha256(v)}
                for k, v in originals.items() if k not in selected]
    known_ids = {r["result_id"] for r in rows}
    for subset in p["sensitivity_sets"]:
        need(set(subset["omit_result_ids"]) <= known_ids, "SENSITIVITY_RESULT_UNKNOWN")
    return {"schema": "stellar-forge.evidence-synthesis-review.v1", "protocol": p,
            "protocol_sha256": content_sha256(p), "rows": rows, "unselected": excluded,
            "conflicts": conflicts,
            "counts": {"published_results": len(originals), "reviewed_results": len(rows),
                       "included_results": sum(r["decision"]["include"] for r in rows),
                       "estimable_results": sum(r["state"] == "ESTIMABLE" for r in rows),
                       "unselected_results": len(excluded), "included_studies": len(studies)},
            "engine": engine_information(), "can_run": not conflicts and any(
                r["decision"]["include"] and r["source_status"] == "RESOLVED" for r in rows)}


def _pool(rows, p, *, model=None, interval=None):
    import numpy as np
    from scipy import stats
    from statsmodels.stats.meta_analysis import combine_effects

    k = len(rows)
    if k < 2:
        return {"status": "SINGLE_STUDY" if k else "NO_ESTIMABLE_STUDIES",
                "k": k, "reason": "At least two independent study estimates are required for pooling."}
    a = p["analysis"]
    model, interval = model or a["model"], interval or a["interval"]
    y = np.asarray([r["effect"]["estimate"] for r in rows], dtype=float)
    v = np.asarray([r["effect"]["variance"] for r in rows], dtype=float)
    method = a["tau_method"] if model == "random" else "pm"
    kwds = {"atol": a["pm_tolerance"], "maxiter": a["pm_max_iterations"]} if method == "pm" else {}
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as observed:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        fit = combine_effects(y, v, method_re=method, row_names=[r["label"] for r in rows],
                              use_t=interval == "hksj", alpha=a["alpha"], **kwds)
    raw_tau = float(fit.tau2)
    need(math.isfinite(raw_tau), "NATIVE_TAU_NOT_FINITE")
    tau = max(0.0, raw_tau) if model == "random" else 0.0
    boundary = model == "random" and raw_tau < 0
    use_common = model == "common" or boundary
    estimate = float(fit.mean_effect_fe if use_common else fit.mean_effect_re)
    variance = float(fit.var_eff_w_fe if use_common else fit.var_eff_w_re)
    scaled_variance = float(fit.var_hksj_fe if use_common else fit.var_hksj_re)
    weights = np.asarray(fit.weights_rel_fe if use_common else fit.weights_rel_re, dtype=float)
    need(math.isfinite(estimate) and variance > 0 and math.isfinite(variance)
         and np.all(np.isfinite(weights)) and np.all(weights > 0), "NATIVE_POOL_NOT_ESTIMABLE")
    q = max(0.0, float(fit.q))
    residual_q = float(np.sum((y - estimate) ** 2 / (v + tau)))
    converged = tau == 0 or method != "pm" or abs(residual_q - (k - 1)) <= max(
        2 * a["pm_tolerance"], 1e-7)
    need(model == "common" or converged, "PM_DID_NOT_CONVERGE")
    selected_variance = scaled_variance if interval == "hksj" else variance
    need(math.isfinite(selected_variance) and selected_variance >= 0, "NATIVE_INTERVAL_NOT_ESTIMABLE")
    se = math.sqrt(selected_variance)
    df = k - 1 if interval == "hksj" else None
    ci = _interval(estimate, se, a["alpha"], df=df)
    statistic = estimate / se if se else None
    pvalue = float(2 * (stats.t.sf(abs(statistic), df) if df is not None
                       else stats.norm.sf(abs(statistic)))) if statistic is not None else None
    notes = []
    if boundary:
        notes.append("The native unbounded DL estimate is negative; the selected nonnegative DL boundary uses the native common-effect mean, variance and scale at tau squared zero.")
    if interval == "hksj" and scaled_variance < variance:
        notes.append("The selected unmodified HKSJ estimated scale is below one; its interval may be narrower than the normal fixed-scale interval.")
    if k < 5 and model == "random":
        notes.append("Between-study variance and interval coverage are imprecise with few studies.")
    if se == 0:
        notes.append("The selected estimated residual scale is zero; its HKSJ interval is degenerate.")
    return {
        "status": "ESTIMATED", "k": k, "model": model,
        "tau_method": method if model == "random" else None,
        "interval_method": "HKSJ estimated scale, t(k-1)" if interval == "hksj" else "normal, fixed scale",
        "alpha": a["alpha"], "estimate": estimate, "standard_error": se,
        "fixed_scale_standard_error": math.sqrt(variance), "interval": ci, "degrees_of_freedom": df,
        "display_estimate": _display(estimate, p["measure"]),
        "display_interval": [_display(x, p["measure"]) for x in ci],
        "measure": p["measure"], "analysis_scale": "log" if p["measure"] in {"RR", "OR", "HR"} else "identity",
        "pvalue": pvalue, "tau_squared": tau, "native_unbounded_tau_squared": raw_tau if model == "random" else None,
        "tau_at_boundary": tau == 0 if model == "random" else None,
        "pm_converged": converged if model == "random" and method == "pm" else None,
        "Q": q, "Q_df": k - 1, "Q_pvalue": float(stats.chi2.sf(q, k - 1)),
        "I_squared_percent": max(0.0, (q - (k - 1)) / q * 100) if q else 0.0,
        "H_squared": q / (k - 1), "residual_Q": residual_q,
        "HKSJ_scale": scaled_variance / variance,
        "weights": [{"result_id": row["result_id"], "study_id": row["study_id"], "weight": float(weight)}
                    for row, weight in zip(rows, weights)],
        "warnings": sorted({str(w.message) for w in observed}), "notes": notes,
    }


def analyze(protocol, descriptors, *, cancelled=lambda: None):
    engine = engine_information(required=True)
    reviewed = review(protocol, descriptors, compute_effects=True, cancelled=cancelled)
    need(not reviewed["conflicts"], "DEPENDENT_STUDIES_REQUIRE_REVIEW")
    p = reviewed["protocol"]
    rows = [r for r in reviewed["rows"] if r["state"] == "ESTIMABLE"]
    cancelled()
    primary = _pool(rows, p)
    common = _pool(rows, p, model="common", interval="normal")
    random_normal = _pool(rows, p, model="random", interval="normal")
    random_hksj = _pool(rows, p, model="random", interval="hksj")
    loo = []
    if p["analysis"]["leave_one_out"] and len(rows) >= 3:
        for omit in rows:
            cancelled()
            selected = [r for r in rows if r["result_id"] != omit["result_id"]]
            pooled = _pool(selected, p)
            loo.append({"omitted_result_id": omit["result_id"], "omitted_study_id": omit["study_id"],
                        "label": omit["label"], "estimate_change": pooled.get("estimate", 0) - primary.get("estimate", 0),
                        "result": pooled})
    subgroups = []
    for definition in p["subgroups"]:
        groups = {}
        for row in rows:
            group = row["decision"].get("subgroups", {}).get(definition["id"])
            groups.setdefault(group, []).append(row)
        estimates = []
        for level, selected in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda pair: (pair[0] is None, str(pair[0]))):
            cancelled()
            estimates.append({"level": level, "missing": level is None,
                              "result_ids": [r["result_id"] for r in selected], "result": _pool(selected, p)})
        subgroups.append({"definition": deepcopy(definition), "levels": estimates,
                          "interpretation": "Descriptive within-subgroup estimates; overlapping confidence intervals are not a subgroup interaction test."})
    sensitivity = []
    for definition in p["sensitivity_sets"]:
        cancelled()
        omit = set(definition["omit_result_ids"])
        selected = [r for r in rows if r["result_id"] not in omit]
        sensitivity.append({"definition": deepcopy(definition), "result": _pool(selected, p)})
    return {"schema": RESULT_SCHEMA, "engine": engine, "review": reviewed,
            "primary": primary, "comparisons": {"common_normal": common,
                "random_normal": random_normal, "random_hksj": random_hksj},
            "leave_one_out": loo, "subgroups": subgroups, "sensitivity_sets": sensitivity,
            "funnel": {"kind": "descriptive", "x_scale": "analysis-effect",
                       "y_scale": "standard-error", "studies": len(rows),
                       "interpretation": "A funnel plot describes the relation between study estimates and precision. Asymmetry alone does not identify publication bias.",
                       "small_sample_note": "Fewer than ten studies provide limited information about funnel asymmetry." if len(rows) < 10 else None},
            "method_notes": [
                "The effect and its sampling variance are calculated from the selected accepted numeric fields. Original lexical values, derivations and source bindings are retained.",
                "Ratios are pooled on the natural-log scale and back-transformed for display. Individual-study intervals use the normal distribution on the analysis scale.",
                "One independent estimate per original Study is selected for each reviewed contrast. Different timepoints, populations, estimands and units require separate reviewed protocols.",
                "PM uses the installed native iterative estimator with the recorded tolerance and iteration limit. DL uses an explicit nonnegative between-study variance boundary.",
                "HKSJ uses the native estimated residual scale and a t reference distribution with k minus one degrees of freedom; no undocumented scale flooring is applied.",
                "Source appraisal judgements and revisions remain in their original descriptors. Sensitivity exclusions are explicit selections and do not overwrite those judgements.",
            ]}

"""Complete citation review on the original Research workspace and request journal.

Draft revisions are local analyst work. Only submit/recover calls the original
atomic review. Delivery selections freeze before/reviewed/current revisions;
portable readers validate the original history and source on cold receive.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import tempfile
import zipfile

from .errors import StateError
from .research_workspace import _CALL, _LIMIT, _json, _value, _file_delivery
from .runtime import Runtime
from .storage import digest, dump, lock, parse, private_directory, read, write, sync_directory

_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.citation-python-delivery.v1"
_DRAFT = "stellar-forge.citation-python-draft.v1"
_INPUT_LIMIT = 16 * 1024 * 1024
_STATE_LIMIT = 32 * 1024 * 1024
_FILE_LIMIT = 256 * 1024 * 1024
_HASH = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{64}")
_NOTICE = re.compile(r"cu_[a-f0-9]{64}")
_REVIEW_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,100}")
_LABELS = ("before", "reviewed", "current")
_FORMATS = ("html", "md", "json", "json.gz")


def _need(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise StateError(code)


def _exists(path):
    return path.exists() or path.is_symlink()


def _object_file(path, maximum=_STATE_LIMIT):
    value = parse(read(Path(path), maximum))
    _need(isinstance(value, dict), "CITATION_JSON_OBJECT_REQUIRED")
    return value


def _immutable(path, value):
    raw = _json(value) + b"\n"
    _need(len(raw) <= _STATE_LIMIT, "CITATION_STATE_TOO_LARGE")
    if _exists(path):
        _need(read(path, _STATE_LIMIT) == raw, "CITATION_LOCAL_RECORD_CHANGED")
    else:
        try:
            write(path, raw, exclusive=True)
        except FileExistsError:
            _need(read(path, _STATE_LIMIT) == raw, "CITATION_LOCAL_RECORD_CHANGED")
    return value


def _pin(path, maximum=_FILE_LIMIT):
    path = Path(path).expanduser().absolute()
    with os.fdopen(os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK), "rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        _need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and 0 <= before.st_size <= maximum,
              "CITATION_REGULAR_FILE_REQUIRED")
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        while block := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
            count += len(block)
            _need(count <= maximum, "CITATION_FILE_TOO_LARGE")
            checksum.update(block)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        fields = ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_size", "st_mtime_ns", "st_ctime_ns")
        _need(count == before.st_size and all(getattr(before, key) == getattr(after, key) for key in fields),
              "CITATION_FILE_CHANGED")
    return {"file": str(path), "bytes": count, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()}


def _workspace_identity(citations, expected=None):
    # A fresh Python client has no bound workspace until the original status
    # handshake. Compare the saved selection before any selected write/export.
    status = citations.workspace.status()
    actual = citations.workspace.workspace_id
    _need(isinstance(actual, str) and re.fullmatch(r"research_[a-f0-9]{64}", actual) and
          status.get("workspaceId") == actual and (expected is None or actual == expected),
          "CITATION_WORKSPACE_CHANGED")
    return actual


def _standalone(checkout, node, action, value, directory, *, environment=None, timeout=900):
    runtime = Runtime(checkout, node=node, environment=environment, timeout=timeout, output_limit=_LIMIT)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".citation-call-", dir=directory) as temporary:
        request = Path(temporary) / "request.json"
        dump(request, {"schema": _CALL, "action": action, "input": value}, exclusive=True)
        result = runtime.run(["--request", request], target="research")
    return _value({"returncode": result.returncode, "runtimeError": result.error,
                   "interrupted": result.interrupted, "native": result.output})


class ResearchCitations:
    """Borrow the existing client; no listener, provider or payment is created."""
    def __init__(self, workspace, dossier_id):
        self.workspace, self.dossier_id = workspace, dossier_id

    def list(self, *, revision=None, offset=0, limit=30, status="all"):
        options = {"offset": offset, "limit": limit, "status": status}
        if revision is not None:
            options["revision"] = revision
        return self.workspace._read("citation-updates", {"dossierId": self.dossier_id, "options": options})

    def iter_notices(self, *, revision=None, status="all", limit=100):
        offset = 0
        while True:
            page = self.list(revision=revision, offset=offset, limit=limit, status=status)
            selected = page["dossier"]["revision"]
            _need(revision is None or revision == selected, "CITATION_PAGE_REVISION_CHANGED")
            revision = selected
            yield from page["items"]
            next_offset = page.get("nextOffset")
            if next_offset is None:
                return
            _need(type(next_offset) is int and next_offset > offset, "CITATION_PAGE_CURSOR_CHANGED")
            offset = next_offset

    def detail(self, notice_id, *, revision=None):
        options = {"noticeId": notice_id}
        if revision is not None:
            options["revision"] = revision
        return self.workspace._read("citation-updates", {"dossierId": self.dossier_id, "options": options})

    def validate(self, request):
        """Use the original Node review-input parser, including its full limits."""
        _need(isinstance(request, dict) and len(_json(request)) <= _INPUT_LIMIT,
              "CITATION_REVIEW_INPUT_TOO_LARGE")
        return self.workspace._read("citation-review-input", {"request": request})

    def review(self, request, *, resume=False, cancel_event=None):
        normalized = self.validate(request)["request"]
        return self.workspace._write("citation-review", {
            "dossierId": self.dossier_id, "body": normalized},
            request_id=normalized["requestId"], replay_safe=True, resume=resume,
            cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def saved_request(self, request_id):
        record = self.workspace.call_record(request_id)
        saved = record["request"]
        _need(saved["action"] == "citation-review" and
              saved["input"].get("dossierId") == self.dossier_id,
              "CITATION_CALL_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        return record

    def recover(self, request_id, *, cancel_event=None):
        self.saved_request(request_id)
        return self.workspace.resume(request_id, cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def draft(self, directory, *, notice_id, request_id, actor, revision=None):
        return CitationReviewDraft.create(self, directory, notice_id=notice_id,
                                          request_id=request_id, actor=actor, revision=revision)

    def delivery(self, request_id, directory, *, current_revision=None):
        return CitationDelivery.prepare(self, request_id, directory, current_revision=current_revision)


class CitationReviewDraft:
    """Full local revisions and an immutable pending request.

    The analyst explicitly edits JSON or uses the setters below. A stale base
    is preserved; it is never silently retargeted to the latest dossier.
    """
    def __init__(self, directory):
        self.directory = private_directory(Path(directory), create=False)
        self.selection = _object_file(self.directory / "selection.json")
        _need(self.selection.get("schema") == _DRAFT, "CITATION_DRAFT_CHANGED")
        self.revisions = private_directory(self.directory / "revisions", create=False)

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, citations, directory, *, notice_id, request_id, actor, revision=None):
        _need(isinstance(request_id, str) and _REVIEW_ID.fullmatch(request_id),
              "CITATION_REVIEW_REQUEST_REQUIRED")
        _need(isinstance(notice_id, str) and _NOTICE.fullmatch(notice_id), "CITATION_NOTICE_INVALID")
        root = private_directory(Path(directory))
        private_directory(root / "revisions")
        private_directory(root / "inputs")
        with lock(root):
            path = root / "selection.json"
            if _exists(path):
                saved = _object_file(path)
                _need(saved.get("dossierId") == citations.dossier_id and
                      saved.get("noticeId") == notice_id and saved.get("requestId") == request_id and
                      saved.get("actor") == actor and
                      (revision is None or saved.get("revision") == revision),
                      "CITATION_DRAFT_SELECTION_CHANGED")
                _workspace_identity(citations, saved.get("workspaceId"))
                selected = saved
            else:
                workspace_id = _workspace_identity(citations)
                page = citations.detail(notice_id, revision=revision)
                selected = {"schema": _DRAFT, "dossierId": citations.dossier_id,
                    "noticeId": notice_id, "requestId": request_id, "actor": actor,
                    "revision": page["dossier"]["revision"],
                    "workspaceId": workspace_id, "original": page}
                _immutable(path, selected)
            detail = selected["original"]["detail"]
            initial = {"requestId": request_id, "noticeId": notice_id,
                "expectedRevision": selected["revision"], "expectedFingerprint": detail["fingerprint"],
                "actor": actor, "decision": "follow-up", "reason": "",
                "evidenceChanges": [{key: row[key] for key in
                    ("occurrenceId", "selected", "classification", "note")} for row in detail["evidence"]],
                "findingChanges": [{key: row[key] for key in
                    ("id", "title", "text", "occurrenceIds")} for row in detail["findings"]],
                "findingDispositions": [{"findingId": row["id"], "disposition": "unchanged", "reason": ""}
                                        for row in detail["findings"]]}
            first = root / "revisions" / "00000001.json"
            if not _exists(first):
                _immutable(first, {"schema": _DRAFT, "editRevision": 1,
                    "previousSha256": None, "request": initial, "sourceInput": None})
        return cls(root)

    def current(self):
        paths = sorted(path for path in self.revisions.iterdir()
                       if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{8}\.json", path.name))
        _need(paths and [p.name for p in paths] ==
              [str(index).zfill(8) + ".json" for index in range(1, len(paths) + 1)],
              "CITATION_DRAFT_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE")
        previous = None
        last = None
        for index, path in enumerate(paths, 1):
            raw = read(path, _STATE_LIMIT)
            value = parse(raw)
            _need(value.get("schema") == _DRAFT and value.get("editRevision") == index and
                  value.get("previousSha256") == previous, "CITATION_DRAFT_HISTORY_CHANGED")
            self._binding(value["request"])
            previous, last = digest(raw), value
