    @staticmethod
    def downloaded_file(result):
        ResearchQuotes._verify_completed("quotes-download", result)
        return _retained_file(result["file"])

    @staticmethod
    def exported_files(result):
        return ResearchQuoteExport(result)

    def copy_export(self, call_id, directory, *, copy_id, resume=False, cancel_event=None):
        """Use the original native publisher to create a complete portable directory."""
        _request_id(call_id); _request_id(copy_id)
        _need(call_id != copy_id, "RESEARCH_QUOTE_DISTINCT_COPY_CALL_REQUIRED")
        with self.workspace._operation(cancel_event) as event:
            saved = self.saved(call_id)
            _need(saved.get("completed") is True and
                  saved["request"]["action"] in {"quotes-export-operation", "quotes-export-case", "quotes-export-tariff"},
                  "RESEARCH_QUOTE_COMPLETE_EXPORT_REQUIRED")
            result = saved["result"]
            selected = {"sourceDirectory": result["directory"], "directory": _absolute(directory),
                        "expectedSelectionSha256": result["selectionSha256"],
                        "expectedWorkspaceId": result["workspaceId"]}
            return self._write("quotes-copy-export", selected, call_id=copy_id,
                               resume=resume, _owned_event=event)

    def saved(self, call_id):
        """Read and verify the first complete reply without contacting a host."""
        saved = self.workspace.call_record(_request_id(call_id))
        request, record = saved["request"], saved.get("result")
        _need(request.get("action") in self._writes and request.get("replaySafe") is True,
              "RESEARCH_QUOTE_SAVED_CALL_REQUIRED")
        if not record:
            return {"request": deepcopy(request), "attempts": saved["attempts"], "completed": False}
        from .research_workspace import _completed_reply, _value
        if not _completed_reply(record):
            return {"request": deepcopy(request), "attempts": saved["attempts"],
                    "completed": False, "attempt": deepcopy(record)}
        result = self._decode(_value(record, call_id), request["action"], request["input"],
                              request["workspaceId"])
        return {"request": deepcopy(request), "attempts": saved["attempts"], "completed": True,
                "result": self._verify_completed(request["action"], result)}

    def recover(self, call_id, *, cancel_event=None):
        """Continue the same recorded action and complete original input."""
        saved = self.workspace.call_record(_request_id(call_id))["request"]
        _need(saved.get("action") in self._writes and saved.get("replaySafe") is True,
              "RESEARCH_QUOTE_SAVED_CALL_REQUIRED")
        with self.workspace._operation(cancel_event) as event:
            descriptor = self.workspace._write_call(saved["action"], saved["input"],
                request_id=call_id, replay_safe=True, resume=True, event=event,
                local=saved.get("local", False))
            return self._verify_completed(saved["action"],
                self._decode(descriptor, saved["action"], saved["input"], saved["workspaceId"]))

    def replay(self, call_id, *, replay_id, cancel_event=None):
        """Explicitly replay the same original request in a separate local attempt.

        The replay can finish an interrupted original write. Its native UUID,
        input bytes, case scope, source selections and review SHA stay unchanged.
        """
        _request_id(call_id); _request_id(replay_id)
        _need(call_id != replay_id, "RESEARCH_QUOTE_DISTINCT_REPLAY_CALL_REQUIRED")
        with self.workspace._operation(cancel_event) as event:
            original = self.workspace.call_record(call_id)["request"]
            _need(original.get("action") in {"quotes-submit", "quotes-replay"} and
                  original.get("replaySafe") is True, "RESEARCH_QUOTE_REPLAY_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
            selected = original["input"]
            source_directory = selected["directory"]
            native = (deepcopy(selected["original"]) if original["action"] == "quotes-replay" else
                      {key: deepcopy(selected[key]) for key in
                       ("command", "caseId", "action", "profile", "inputFile", "inputSha256", "inputBytes")
                       if key in selected})
            native["workspaceId"] = original["workspaceId"]
            value = {"sourceDirectory": source_directory, "original": native}
            return self._write("quotes-replay", value, call_id=replay_id, resume=True, _owned_event=event)

    def inspect_run(self, call_id, *, cancel_event=None):
        """Read the original native request, attempts, selection and complete files."""
        original = self.workspace.call_record(_request_id(call_id))["request"]
        _need(original.get("action") in self._writes - {"quotes-copy-export", "quotes-download"},
              "RESEARCH_QUOTE_OPERATOR_CALL_REQUIRED")
        return self._read("quotes-run-inspect", {"directory": original["input"]["directory"]},
                          cancel_event=cancel_event)

"""Study Flow on the original Research dossier, transport and request journal.

No flow arithmetic, source acquisition, server or independent history lives here.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import re

from .errors import StateError
from .research_workspace import _json, _request_id
from .storage import read

FLOW_SECTIONS = ("overview", "flows", "editions", "records", "reports", "studies",
                 "counts", "issues", "operations")
FLOW_CSV_SECTIONS = ("counts", "records", "reports", "studies", "reasons", "issues")
FLOW_FORMATS = ("json", "svg", "html", "csv")
_INPUT_LIMIT = 16 * 1024 * 1024
_MAX_INTEGER = 9007199254740991


def _need(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise StateError(code)


def _id(value):
    _need(isinstance(value, str) and 0 < len(value) <= 160 and
          not any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 or c in "/\\" for c in value),
          "FLOW_ID_REQUIRED")
    return value


def _revision(value):
    _need(type(value) is int and 1 <= value <= _MAX_INTEGER,
          "FLOW_REVISION_REQUIRED")
    return value


def _options(revision, **selection):
    result = {}
    if revision is not None:
        result["revision"] = _revision(revision)
    for key, value in selection.items():
        if value is not None:
            result[key] = _id(value)
    return result


def _page(options, offset, limit):
    _need(type(offset) is int and 0 <= offset <= _MAX_INTEGER and
          type(limit) is int and 1 <= limit <= 100, "FLOW_PAGE_INVALID")
    _need(offset == 0 or "revision" in options, "FLOW_PAGE_REVISION_REQUIRED")
    return {**options, "offset": offset, "limit": limit}


def _body(value):
    _need(isinstance(value, dict), "FLOW_INPUT_OBJECT_REQUIRED")
    result = deepcopy(value)
    _need(len(_json(result)) <= _INPUT_LIMIT, "FLOW_INPUT_TOO_LARGE")
    return result


def _review_request(value):
    # The original domain parser validates the whole definition, source basis
    # and action data. Keep the caller's envelope and JSON values unchanged.
    value = _body(value)
    _need(set(value).issubset({"requestId", "expectedRevision", "actor", "action", "flowId", "data"})
          and {"requestId", "expectedRevision", "actor", "action", "data"}.issubset(value),
          "FLOW_REQUEST_FIELDS_INVALID")
    _request_id(value["requestId"])
    _need(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,100}", value["requestId"]) is not None,
          "FLOW_REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED")
    _revision(value["expectedRevision"])
    _need(value["action"] in ("save", "review", "withdraw") and
          isinstance(value["data"], dict), "FLOW_ACTION_INVALID")
    _need(isinstance(value["actor"], dict), "FLOW_ACTOR_REQUIRED")
    if "flowId" in value:
        _id(value["flowId"])
    return value


class ResearchStudyFlow:
    """Operate a selected dossier through one existing ResearchWorkspace."""

    def __init__(self, workspace, dossier_id):
        self.workspace, self.dossier_id = workspace, _id(dossier_id)

    def read(self, *, revision=None, flow_id=None, edition_id=None,
             section="overview", offset=0, limit=30, cancel_event=None):
        _need(section in FLOW_SECTIONS, "FLOW_SECTION_INVALID")
        options = _page(_options(revision, flowId=flow_id, editionId=edition_id), offset, limit)
        options["section"] = section
        return self.workspace._read("study-flow", {
            "dossierId": self.dossier_id, "options": options}, cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def sources(self, *, revision=None, question_id=None, review_id=None,
                work_set_id=None, offset=0, limit=30, cancel_event=None):
        options = _page(_options(revision, questionId=question_id,
                                reviewId=review_id, workSetId=work_set_id), offset, limit)
        return self.workspace._read("study-flow-sources", {
            "dossierId": self.dossier_id, "options": options}, cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def _rows(self, page, revision, offset, section, total=None):
        _need(isinstance(page, dict) and isinstance(page.get("dossier"), dict) and
              page["dossier"].get("id") == self.dossier_id,
              "FLOW_PAGE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        selected = _revision(page["dossier"].get("revision"))
        _need(revision is None or selected == revision, "FLOW_PAGE_REVISION_CHANGED")
        _need(page.get("section") == section and page.get("offset") == offset and
              isinstance(page.get("items"), list) and type(page.get("total")) is int and
              page["total"] >= offset + len(page["items"]), "FLOW_PAGE_CHANGED")
        _need(total is None or total == page["total"], "FLOW_PAGE_TOTAL_CHANGED")
        following = page.get("nextOffset")
        end = offset + len(page["items"])
        _need((following is None and end == page["total"]) or
              (type(following) is int and following == end and offset < end < page["total"]),
              "FLOW_PAGE_CURSOR_CHANGED")
        return selected, page["items"], following, page["total"]

    def iter_records(self, *, section, revision=None, flow_id=None, edition_id=None,
                     limit=100, cancel_event=None):
        """Yield every selected row, pinning the first returned dossier revision."""
        _need(section in FLOW_SECTIONS and section != "overview", "FLOW_ROWS_SECTION_REQUIRED")
        offset, total = 0, None
        while True:
            page = self.read(revision=revision, flow_id=flow_id, edition_id=edition_id,
                             section=section, offset=offset, limit=limit, cancel_event=cancel_event)
            revision, rows, following, total = self._rows(page, revision, offset, section, total)
            yield from rows
            if following is None:
                return
            offset = following

    def iter_sources(self, *, revision=None, question_id=None, review_id=None,
                     work_set_id=None, limit=100, cancel_event=None):
        """Yield all original occurrences without mixing current source revisions."""
        offset, total = 0, None
        while True:
            page = self.sources(revision=revision, question_id=question_id,
                                review_id=review_id, work_set_id=work_set_id,
                                offset=offset, limit=limit, cancel_event=cancel_event)
            revision, rows, following, total = self._rows(page, revision, offset, "source", total)
            yield from rows
            if following is None:
                return
            offset = following

    def report(self, *, revision=None, flow_id=None, edition_id=None, cancel_event=None):
        return self.workspace._read("study-flow-report", {
            "dossierId": self.dossier_id,
            "options": _options(revision, flowId=flow_id, editionId=edition_id)},
            cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def preview(self, definition, *, expected_revision, flow_id=None,
                source_mode="current", basis_edition_id=None, cancel_event=None):
        """Ask the original engine to assess an unsaved definition at the current head."""
        _need(source_mode in ("current", "retained"), "FLOW_SOURCE_MODE_INVALID")
        body = {"expectedRevision": _revision(expected_revision),
                "definition": deepcopy(definition), "sourceMode": source_mode}
        if flow_id is not None:
            body["flowId"] = _id(flow_id)
        if basis_edition_id is not None:
            body["basisEditionId"] = _id(basis_edition_id)
        return self.workspace._read("study-flow-preview", {
            "dossierId": self.dossier_id, "body": _body(body)}, cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def import_counts(self, body, *, filename, expected_revision, reason,
                      reference=None, cancel_event=None):
        """Parse the complete original CSV without committing a review or revision."""
        _need(isinstance(body, str) and isinstance(filename, str) and
              isinstance(reason, str), "FLOW_COUNT_INPUT_REQUIRED")
        value = {"expectedRevision": _revision(expected_revision), "body": body,
                 "filename": filename, "reason": reason}
        if reference is not None:
            value["reference"] = reference
        return self.workspace._read("study-flow-import-counts", {
            "dossierId": self.dossier_id, "body": _body(value)}, cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def import_counts_file(self, file, *, expected_revision, reason, reference=None, cancel_event=None):
        """Strict UTF-8 decoding retains BOM, CRLF and every original character."""
        file = Path(file)
        original = read(file, _INPUT_LIMIT)
        body = original.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
        _need(body.encode("utf-8") == original, "FLOW_CSV_ENCODING_CHANGED")
        return self.import_counts(body, filename=file.name, expected_revision=expected_revision,
                                  reason=reason, reference=reference, cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def review(self, request, *, resume=False, cancel_event=None):
        """Retain and submit one exact save, review or withdrawal request."""
        value = _review_request(request)
        return self.workspace._write("study-flow-review",
            {"dossierId": self.dossier_id, "body": value},
            request_id=value["requestId"], replay_safe=True, resume=resume,
            cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def saved_request(self, request_id):
        record = self.workspace.call_record(request_id)
        saved = record["request"]
        _need(saved["action"] == "study-flow-review" and
              saved["input"].get("dossierId") == self.dossier_id,
              "FLOW_CALL_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        return record

    def recover(self, request_id, *, cancel_event=None):
        """Resume only the retained request, with the same expected revision and actor."""
        self.saved_request(request_id)
        return self.workspace.resume(request_id, cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def export(self, file, *, revision, flow_id=None, edition_id=None,
               format="json", section=None, expected_sha256=None, cancel_event=None):
        """Publish the original complete native file and verify its retained bytes."""
        _need(format in FLOW_FORMATS, "FLOW_EXPORT_FORMAT_INVALID")
        _need(section is None or format == "csv" and section in FLOW_CSV_SECTIONS,
              "FLOW_EXPORT_SECTION_INVALID")
        options = _options(_revision(revision), flowId=flow_id, editionId=edition_id)
        options["format"] = format
        if section is not None:
            options["section"] = section
        with self.workspace._operation(cancel_event) as event:
            return self.workspace._download("study-flow-export",
                {"dossierId": self.dossier_id, "options": options},
                file=file, expected_sha256=expected_sha256, _owned_event=event)

    def export_portable(self, file, *, revision, format="json.gz",
                        expected_sha256=None, cancel_event=None):
        """Download the original complete dossier archive, including all flow history."""
        _need(format in ("json", "json.gz"), "FLOW_PORTABLE_FORMAT_INVALID")
        with self.workspace._operation(cancel_event) as event:
            return self.workspace._download("export-dossier",
                {"dossierId": self.dossier_id,
                 "options": {"revision": _revision(revision), "format": format}},
                file=file, expected_sha256=expected_sha256, _owned_event=event)

"""Retain exact source documents inside the original Analysis workspace.

This is local document custody for public captures and operator-selected files.
The existing response projection, DatasetDatabase, SQL and export jobs remain
the owners of analysis. Relative content addresses survive a workspace restore.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import tempfile
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

from .errors import StateError
from .result import FileDelivery
from .storage import digest, parse, private_directory, read, sync_directory, write

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.analysis-source-document.v1"
DIRECTORY = "analysis-response-documents"
MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 1_048_576
MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_JSON_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ORIGINAL_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024
_HASH = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{64}")
_FILE = re.compile(r"files/([a-f0-9]{64})\.(json|csv|bin|txt)")
_MIME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9!#$&^_.+-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$&^_.+-]+(?:;[ -~]{1,160})?")
_CHUNK = 1024 * 1024


def _need(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise StateError("ANALYSIS_DOCUMENT_" + code)


def _text(value, maximum, *, empty=False):
    _need(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) <= maximum and
          (empty or bool(value.strip())) and "\x00" not in value, "TEXT_INVALID")
    return value


def _url(value):
    _text(value, 3000)
    try:
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        _need(parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname and not parsed.username and
              not parsed.password and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment and
              not any(ord(c) <= 32 for c in value), "PUBLIC_SOURCE_URL_INVALID")
        port = parsed.port
    except ValueError:
        raise StateError("ANALYSIS_DOCUMENT_PUBLIC_SOURCE_URL_INVALID") from None
    _need(port is None or 1 <= port <= 65535, "PUBLIC_SOURCE_URL_INVALID")
    # Keep the actual published URL; credentials and transient query state are
    # deliberately not part of a reusable document source reference.
    _need(urlunsplit(parsed) == value, "PUBLIC_SOURCE_URL_INVALID")
    return value


def _keys(value, required, optional=()):
    _need(isinstance(value, dict) and set(required) <= value.keys() and
          value.keys() <= set(required) | set(optional), "FIELDS_INVALID")


def _file(value, *, original=False):
    required = {"path", "bytes", "sha256", "contentType"}
    _keys(value, required | ({"role"} if original else set()),
          {"sourceUrl"} if original else set())
    match = _FILE.fullmatch(value.get("path", "")) if isinstance(value.get("path"), str) else None
    _need(match and match[1] == value.get("sha256"), "CONTENT_ADDRESS_INVALID")
    limit = MAX_ORIGINAL_BYTES if original else MAX_SOURCE_BYTES
    _need(type(value.get("bytes")) is int and 0 <= value["bytes"] <= limit, "FILE_SIZE_INVALID")
    _need(isinstance(value.get("contentType"), str) and _MIME.fullmatch(value["contentType"]),
          "CONTENT_TYPE_INVALID")
    if original:
        _text(value.get("role"), 80)
        if "sourceUrl" in value:
            _url(value["sourceUrl"])
    return value


def validate_manifest(value):
    """Validate the portable v1 descriptor without touching files or a database."""
    _keys(value, {"schema", "title", "format", "document", "originals", "provenance", "complete"})
    _need(value["schema"] == SCHEMA, "SCHEMA_INVALID")
    _text(value["title"], 200)
    _need(isinstance(value["format"], str) and value["format"] in {"json", "csv"}, "FORMAT_INVALID")
    document = _file(value["document"])
    _need(document["path"].endswith("." + value["format"]), "FORMAT_PATH_MISMATCH")
    _need(value["format"] != "json" or document["bytes"] <= MAX_JSON_BYTES, "JSON_SIZE_INVALID")
    _need(type(value["complete"]) is bool, "COMPLETION_REQUIRED")
    originals = value["originals"]
    _need(isinstance(originals, list) and len(originals) <= 32, "ORIGINALS_INVALID")
    roles = set()
    for item in originals:
        _file(item, original=True)
        _need(item["role"] not in roles, "DUPLICATE_ORIGINAL_ROLE")
        roles.add(item["role"])
    provenance = value["provenance"]
    _keys(provenance, {"kind", "publisher", "capturedAt", "scope", "description"},
          {"sourceUrl", "transform"})
    _need(isinstance(provenance["kind"], str) and provenance["kind"] in {"public-source", "operator-file"}, "ORIGIN_INVALID")
    _text(provenance["publisher"], 200)
    _text(provenance["scope"], 500)
    _text(provenance["description"], 12000, empty=True)
    _text(provenance["capturedAt"], 80)
    try:
        captured = datetime.fromisoformat(provenance["capturedAt"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        _need(captured.utcoffset() is not None, "CAPTURE_TIME_OFFSET_REQUIRED")
    except ValueError:
        raise StateError("ANALYSIS_DOCUMENT_CAPTURE_TIME_INVALID") from None
    if provenance["kind"] == "public-source":
        _need("sourceUrl" in provenance, "PUBLIC_SOURCE_URL_REQUIRED")
    if "sourceUrl" in provenance:
        _url(provenance["sourceUrl"])
    if "transform" in provenance:
        transform = provenance["transform"]
        _keys(transform, {"name", "sourceUrl", "sha256"})
        _text(transform["name"], 200)
        _url(transform["sourceUrl"])
        _need(isinstance(transform["sha256"], str) and _HASH.fullmatch(transform["sha256"]),
              "TRANSFORM_DIGEST_INVALID")
    records = _unique_files(value)
    _need(sum(item["bytes"] for item in records) <= MAX_SOURCE_BYTES, "TOTAL_SOURCE_SIZE_INVALID")
    return value


def _unique_files(manifest):
    records = {}
    for item in [manifest["document"], *manifest["originals"]]:
        selected = {key: item[key] for key in ("path", "bytes", "sha256", "contentType")}
        old = records.get(item["path"])
        _need(old is None or old == selected, "CONFLICTING_FILE_IDENTITY")
        records[item["path"]] = selected
    return [records[name] for name in sorted(records)]


def _manifest(path):
    path = Path(path).expanduser().absolute()
    raw = read(path, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)
    _need(raw, "MANIFEST_EMPTY")
    value = validate_manifest(parse(raw))
    return value, raw


def _root(path):
    path = Path(path).expanduser().absolute()
    try:
        info = path.lstat()
        _need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode), "DIRECTORY_REQUIRED")
        return path.resolve(strict=True)
    except OSError:
        raise StateError("ANALYSIS_DOCUMENT_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE") from None


def _payload(root, record):
    root = _root(root)
    # v1 permits exactly one directory and a content-addressed regular file.
    parent = root / "files"
    _need(_root(parent) == parent, "PAYLOAD_DIRECTORY_CHANGED")
    return parent / record["path"].split("/", 1)[1]


def _delivery(root, record, *, source_files=None):
    path = _payload(root, record) if source_files is None else source_files[record["path"]]
    return FileDelivery({"returncode": 0, "native": {
        "status": "RETAINED_SOURCE_DOCUMENT",
        "file": {"path": str(path), **{key: record[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "contentType")}},
    }}, path, MAX_SOURCE_BYTES)


def _signature(info):
    return info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns, info.st_ctime_ns



def _settle_publication(path, stream, prefix):
    """Finish an interrupted no-replace publication in its owned directory."""
    info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        current = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=directory_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
        _need(stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode) and
              (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (info.st_dev, info.st_ino),
              "PUBLISHED_FILE_CHANGED")
        # Only the writer's temporary hard links to this verified final inode
        # are removable. Other files, symlinks and unrelated temporary writes
        # stay untouched, including another registration's unfinished copy.
        for name in os.listdir(directory_fd):
            if not name.startswith(prefix):
                continue
            try:
                alias = os.stat(name, dir_fd=directory_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                continue
            if (stat.S_ISREG(alias.st_mode) and
                    (alias.st_dev, alias.st_ino) == (info.st_dev, info.st_ino)):
                try:
                    os.unlink(name, dir_fd=directory_fd)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
        current = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=directory_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
        settled = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        _need(stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode) and
              (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (info.st_dev, info.st_ino) and
              (settled.st_size, settled.st_mtime_ns) == (info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns),
              "PUBLISHED_FILE_CHANGED")
        _need(settled.st_nlink == 1, "PUBLICATION_LINKS_UNSETTLED")
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)


def _publish_file(origin, target, record, *, source_files=None):
    destination = _payload(target, record)
    if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink():
        with _delivery(target, record).open() as retained:
            _settle_publication(destination, retained, ".document-")
        return
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".document-", dir=destination.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output, _delivery(origin, record, source_files=source_files).open() as source:
            before = os.fstat(source.fileno())
            count, checksum = 0, hashlib.sha256()
            while block := source.read(_CHUNK):
                count += len(block)
                _need(count <= record["bytes"], "SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_COPY")
                checksum.update(block)
                output.write(block)
            _need(count == record["bytes"] and checksum.hexdigest() == record["sha256"] and
                  _signature(before) == _signature(os.fstat(source.fileno())),
                  "SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_COPY")
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        try:
            os.link(temporary, destination)
            sync_directory(destination.parent)
        except FileExistsError:
            # Another identical registration may have published first. Existing
            # custody is verified and reused; it is never replaced.
            with _delivery(target, record).open():
                pass
    finally:
        try:
            os.unlink(temporary)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass

    with _delivery(target, record).open() as retained:
        _settle_publication(destination, retained, ".document-")


def document_path(directory, document_id):
    """Resolve an original document ID in the current (possibly restored) DB."""
    _need(isinstance(document_id, str) and _HASH.fullmatch(document_id), "ID_INVALID")
    root = private_directory(Path(directory), create=False)
    collection = root / DIRECTORY
    _need(private_directory(collection, create=False) == collection, "DIRECTORY_CHANGED")
    selected = collection / document_id
    _need(private_directory(selected, create=False) == selected, "DIRECTORY_CHANGED")
    return selected / "source.json"


def retain_document(manifest_file, directory, *, source_files=None):
    """Copy one exact reviewed source closure; publish its original manifest last.

    Interrupted copies resume by verifying already-published content addresses.
    source_files optionally maps every original descriptor path to an explicit
    regular input file, such as a retained downloader\'s numbered local names.
    The original descriptor bytes and document identity remain unchanged; the
    same verified publisher copies directly into this existing document store.
    Nothing opens a provider or changes another source registration.
    """
    manifest_file = Path(manifest_file).expanduser().absolute()
    manifest, raw = _manifest(manifest_file)
    document_id = digest(raw)
    origin = _root(manifest_file.parent)
    if source_files is not None:
        expected = {record["path"] for record in _unique_files(manifest)}
        _need(isinstance(source_files, dict) and set(source_files) == expected,
              "SOURCE_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
        selected = {}
        for relative, value in source_files.items():
            _need(isinstance(value, (str, Path)), "SOURCE_FILE_PATH_INVALID")
            path = Path(value).expanduser().absolute()
            _need(_root(path.parent) == path.parent and path.resolve() == path,
                  "SOURCE_FILE_PATH_CHANGED")
            selected[relative] = path
        source_files = selected
    root = private_directory(Path(directory), create=False)
    collection = private_directory(root / DIRECTORY)
    _need(collection == root / DIRECTORY, "DIRECTORY_CHANGED")
    target = private_directory(collection / document_id)
    _need(target == collection / document_id, "DIRECTORY_CHANGED")
    private_directory(target / "files")
    for record in _unique_files(manifest):
        _publish_file(origin, target, record, source_files=source_files)
    # Source metadata cannot change while its files are being retained.
    after = read(manifest_file, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)
    _need(after == raw, "MANIFEST_CHANGED_DURING_COPY")
    destination = target / "source.json"
    try:
        write(destination, raw, exclusive=True)
    except FileExistsError:
        _need(read(destination, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES) == raw, "MANIFEST_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
    manifest_delivery = FileDelivery({"returncode": 0, "native": {
        "status": "RETAINED_SOURCE_DOCUMENT",
        "file": {"path": str(destination), "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": document_id,
                 "contentType": "application/json"},
    }}, destination, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)
    with manifest_delivery.open() as retained:
        _settle_publication(destination, retained, ".write-")
    # Make both complete publication and newly created ancestry durable before
    # the caller can register this source in the original SQLite database.
    for completed_directory in (target / "files", target, collection, root):
        sync_directory(completed_directory)
    return {"document_id": document_id, "manifest": str(destination), "bytes": len(raw),
            "title": manifest["title"], "format": manifest["format"]}


def read_document_source(paths, format=None):
    """Return the existing ResponseSource constructor inputs from retained bytes."""
    manifest_file = Path(paths["manifest"]).expanduser().absolute()
    manifest, raw = _manifest(manifest_file)
    root = _root(manifest_file.parent)
    document_id = digest(raw)
    if paths.get("document_id") is not None:
        _need(paths["document_id"] == document_id, "REGISTERED_ID_CHANGED")
    _need(format is None or format == manifest["format"], "SELECTED_FORMAT_MISMATCH")
    inputs = [{"role": "source-document", "path": str(manifest_file),
               "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": document_id}]
    for record in manifest["originals"]:
        delivery = _delivery(root, record)
        with delivery.open():
            pass
        inputs.append({"role": record["role"], "path": str(delivery.expected_destination),
                       "bytes": record["bytes"], "sha256": record["sha256"]})
    context = {
        "nativeKind": "RETAINED_SOURCE_DOCUMENT",
        "nativeStatus": "RETAINED",
        "transportComplete": manifest["complete"],
        "documentId": document_id, "title": manifest["title"],
        "provenance": manifest["provenance"],
        "originalDocuments": [{key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "path"}
                              for record in manifest["originals"]],
    }
    return _delivery(root, manifest["document"]), None, manifest["format"], inputs, context


def allowed_document_payload(relative):
    """Exact data-only path grammar for the original WorkspaceArchives owner."""
    return isinstance(relative, str) and bool(re.fullmatch(
        r"analysis-response-documents/[a-f0-9]{64}/(?:source\.json|files/[a-f0-9]{64}\.(?:json|csv|bin|txt))",
        relative))


def retained_document_files(directory, document_id):
    """Verified file descriptors for one DB-referenced document, with no abs paths.

    WorkspaceArchives calls this from its existing SQLite snapshot selection.
    The returned data-only names are relative to that same database directory.
    """
    manifest_path = document_path(directory, document_id)
    manifest, raw = _manifest(manifest_path)
    _need(digest(raw) == document_id, "REGISTERED_ID_CHANGED")
    prefix = DIRECTORY + "/" + document_id + "/"
    records = [{"path": prefix + "source.json", "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": document_id}]
    for item in _unique_files(manifest):
        with _delivery(manifest_path.parent, item).open():
            pass
        records.append({"path": prefix + item["path"], "bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]})
    return sorted(records, key=lambda item: item["path"])


def snapshot_document_files(directory, connection):
    """Select all original registered document revisions in the owner's snapshot."""
    exists = connection.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='sf_analysis_response_sources'"
    ).fetchone()
    if exists is None:
        return []
    documents = set()
    for row in connection.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_analysis_response_sources ORDER BY name,revision"):
        source = parse(row[0].encode())
        if source.get("input_kind") == "document":
            document_id = source.get("document_id")
            _need(isinstance(document_id, str) and _HASH.fullmatch(document_id), "REGISTERED_ID_INVALID")
            documents.add(document_id)
    result = {}
    for document_id in sorted(documents):
        for item in retained_document_files(directory, document_id):
            previous = result.get(item["path"])
            _need(previous is None or previous == item, "SNAPSHOT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT")
            result[item["path"]] = item
    return [result[path] for path in sorted(result)]

"""Retain original stream and MCP source files inside an Analysis workspace.

The content address is the existing response identity. Original registrations,
payment observations, raw bytes and stream completion remain unchanged. The
normal native readers verify a relocated copy; this module never acquires data.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from contextlib import contextmanager
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat

from .errors import StateError
from .storage import digest, parse, private_directory, read, sync_directory

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.analysis-retained-response.v1"
ROOT = "analysis-response-sources"
_HASH = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{64}")
_QUOTE = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{8}(?:-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}")
_MAX_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024
_MAX_BINDING = 4 * 1024 * 1024


def _need(ok, code):
    if not ok:
        raise StateError(code)


def _json(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, sort_keys=True,
                       separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()


def _identity(source):
    value = source.get("identity")
    identifier = source.get("source_sha256")
    _need(source.get("kind") == "response" and source.get("input_kind") in {"stream", "mcp"}
          and isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(identifier, str) and _HASH.fullmatch(identifier)
          and value.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.analysis-response-source.v1"
          and value.get("format") == source.get("format")
          and digest(_json(value).rstrip(b"\n")) == identifier,
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    return identifier


def _row(role, path, value):
    _need(isinstance(value, dict) and type(value.get("bytes")) is int
          and 0 <= value["bytes"] <= _MAX_BYTES
          and isinstance(value.get("sha256"), str) and _HASH.fullmatch(value["sha256"]),
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_FILE_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    return {"role": role, "path": path, "bytes": value["bytes"], "sha256": value["sha256"]}


def expected_files(source):
    _identity(source)
    identity = source["identity"]
    inputs = identity.get("inputFiles")
    _need(isinstance(inputs, list) and all(isinstance(x, dict) for x in inputs),
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_INPUTS_INVALID")
    by_role = {x.get("role"): x for x in inputs}
    _need(len(by_role) == len(inputs), "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_INPUTS_INVALID")
    if source["input_kind"] == "stream":
        _need(set(by_role) == {"manifest", "request"} and source["format"] in {"sse", "ndjson"},
              "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_STREAM_INPUTS_INVALID")
        return sorted([
            _row("manifest", "manifest.json", by_role["manifest"]),
            _row("request", "source.json", by_role["request"]),
            _row("records", "records.jsonl", identity.get("retainedFile")),
            _row("response", "response.bin", {
                "bytes": identity.get("original", {}).get("sourceBytes"),
                "sha256": identity.get("original", {}).get("sourceSha256")}),
        ], key=lambda x: x["path"])
    quote = identity.get("original", {}).get("quoteId")
    _need(set(by_role) == {"manifest"} and isinstance(quote, str) and _QUOTE.fullmatch(quote)
          and source["format"] == "json", "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_MCP_INPUTS_INVALID")
    return sorted([
        _row("manifest", quote + ".meta.json", by_role["manifest"]),
        _row("response", quote + ".json", identity.get("retainedFile")),
    ], key=lambda x: x["path"])


def allowed_response_payload(path):
    if not isinstance(path, str):
        return False
    return bool(re.fullmatch(
        ROOT + r"/[a-f0-9]{64}/(?:capsule\.json|manifest\.json|source\.json|records\.jsonl|response\.bin|"
        r"[a-f0-9]{8}(?:-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}(?:\.meta)?\.json)", path))


def _stamp(info):
    return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns, info.st_ctime_ns)


@contextmanager
def _file(path):
    path = Path(path)
    _need(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve() == path, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_PATH_INVALID")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        _need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not info.st_mode & 0o077
              and info.st_uid == os.geteuid() and info.st_size <= _MAX_BYTES,
              "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_PRIVATE_FILE_REQUIRED")
        yield stream


def _file_identity(path):
    with _file(path) as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        checksum, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        while block := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
            size += len(block)
            _need(size <= _MAX_BYTES, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE")
            checksum.update(block)
        _need(_stamp(before) == _stamp(os.fstat(stream.fileno())) and size == before.st_size,
              "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_CHANGED")
    return {"bytes": size, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()}


def _directory(path):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    if not os.path.lexists(path):
        _directory(path.parent)
        try:
            path.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        except FileExistsError:
            pass
    info = path.lstat()
    _need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not info.st_mode & 0o077
          and info.st_uid == os.geteuid() and path.resolve() == path,
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED")
    # Complete a prior interrupted mkdir even when both entries now exist.
    sync_directory(path)
    sync_directory(path.parent)
    return path


def _folder(root, identifier):
    return Path(root).expanduser().absolute() / ROOT / identifier


def inspect_response(folder, source):
    identifier = _identity(source)
    selected = Path(folder).expanduser().absolute()
    _need(selected.resolve() == selected, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_PATH_INVALID")
    folder = private_directory(selected, create=False)
    path = folder / "capsule.json"
    capsule = parse(read(path, _MAX_BINDING))
    expected = expected_files(source)
    _need(isinstance(capsule, dict) and capsule.get("schema") == SCHEMA
          and capsule.get("source_sha256") == identifier
          and capsule.get("input_kind") == source["input_kind"]
          and capsule.get("format") == source["format"]
          and capsule.get("identity") == source["identity"]
          and capsule.get("files") == expected,
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_CAPSULE_CHANGED")
    originals = capsule.get("original_paths")
    _need(isinstance(originals, dict) and set(originals) == {x["role"] for x in expected}
          and all(isinstance(x, str) and x.startswith("/") and "\0" not in x for x in originals.values()),
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_ORIGIN_INVALID")
    _need({x.name for x in folder.iterdir()} == {"capsule.json", *(x["path"] for x in expected)},
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_FILE_SET_CHANGED")
    files = []
    for row in expected:
        actual = _file_identity(folder / row["path"])
        _need(actual == {k: row[k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")},
              "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_FILE_CHANGED")
        files.append({"path": ROOT + "/" + identifier + "/" + row["path"], **actual})
    files.append({"path": ROOT + "/" + identifier + "/capsule.json", **_file_identity(path)})
    return capsule, sorted(files, key=lambda x: x["path"])


def _located(source, folder):
    if source["input_kind"] == "stream":
        paths = {"stream": str(folder), "manifest": str(folder / "manifest.json"),
                 "request": str(folder / "source.json")}
    else:
        quote = source["identity"]["original"]["quoteId"]
        paths = {"manifest": str(folder / (quote + ".meta.json")), "retained": str(folder)}
    return {**source, "paths": paths}


def locate_response(root, source):
    """Resolve a retained local copy without changing the original DB record."""
    if source.get("input_kind") not in {"stream", "mcp"} or not source.get("source_sha256"):
        return source
    folder = _folder(root, _identity(source))
    if not os.path.lexists(folder):
        return source
    inspect_response(folder, source)
    return _located(source, folder)


def _copy(original, destination, expected):
    if os.path.lexists(destination):
        _need(_file_identity(destination) == {k: expected[k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256")},
              "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_STAGING_CHANGED")
        sync_directory(destination.parent)
        return
    part = destination.with_name("." + destination.name + ".partial")
    fd = os.open(part, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as target:
        info = os.fstat(target.fileno())
        _need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_uid == os.geteuid()
              and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_PART_INVALID")
        os.ftruncate(target.fileno(), 0)
        with _file(original) as source:
            before = os.fstat(source.fileno())
            checksum, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
            while block := source.read(1024 * 1024):
                size += len(block)
                _need(size <= expected["bytes"], "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_CHANGED")
                checksum.update(block)
                target.write(block)
            _need(size == expected["bytes"] and checksum.hexdigest() == expected["sha256"]
                  and _stamp(before) == _stamp(os.fstat(source.fileno())),
                  "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_CHANGED")
        target.flush()
        os.fsync(target.fileno())
    os.replace(part, destination)
    sync_directory(destination.parent)


def retain_response(root, source, *, checkout=None, node="node"):
    """Copy one registered original source, then verify its native relocated view."""
    from .response_tables import open_source
    identifier = _identity(source)
    root = private_directory(Path(root), create=False)
    parent = _directory(root / ROOT)
    target, stage = parent / identifier, parent / ("." + identifier + ".receiving")
    fd = os.open(parent / ("." + identifier + ".lock"), os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(fd)
        _need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_uid == os.geteuid()
              and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_LOCK_INVALID")
        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        if os.path.lexists(target):
            capsule, files = inspect_response(target, source)
            opened = open_source(_located(source, target), checkout=checkout, node=node)
            with opened.file.open():
                pass
            opened.check_inputs()
            sync_directory(target)
            sync_directory(parent)
            return {"schema": SCHEMA, "source_sha256": identifier, "state": "RETAINED",
                    "directory": str(target), "files": files, "reused": True}
        stage = _directory(stage)
        expected = expected_files(source)
        opened = open_source(source, checkout=checkout, node=node)
        with opened.file.open():
            pass
        opened.check_inputs()
        originals = {x["role"]: x["path"] for x in opened.inputs}
        if source["input_kind"] == "stream":
            manifest = parse(read(Path(originals["manifest"]), 1_048_576))
            originals.update(records=str(opened.file.expected_destination), response=manifest["source"]["path"])
        else:
            originals["response"] = str(opened.file.expected_destination)
        for row in expected:
            _copy(Path(originals[row["role"]]), stage / row["path"], row)
        capsule = {"schema": SCHEMA, "source_sha256": identifier, "input_kind": source["input_kind"],
                   "format": source["format"], "identity": source["identity"], "files": expected,
                   "original_paths": originals}
        encoded = _json(capsule)
        binding = stage / "capsule.json"
        if os.path.lexists(binding):
            _need(read(binding, _MAX_BINDING) == encoded, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_STAGING_CHANGED")
        else:
            part = stage / ".capsule.json.partial"
            outfd = os.open(part, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
            with os.fdopen(outfd, "wb") as output:
                info = os.fstat(output.fileno())
                _need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_uid == os.geteuid()
                      and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_PART_INVALID")
                os.ftruncate(output.fileno(), 0)
                output.write(encoded)
                output.flush()
                os.fsync(output.fileno())
            os.replace(part, binding)
            sync_directory(stage)
        inspect_response(stage, source)
        received = open_source(_located(source, stage), checkout=checkout, node=node)
        with received.file.open():
            pass
        received.check_inputs()
        sync_directory(stage)
        os.rename(stage, target)
        sync_directory(parent)
        capsule, files = inspect_response(target, source)
        return {"schema": SCHEMA, "source_sha256": identifier, "state": "RETAINED",
                "directory": str(target), "files": files, "reused": False}
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def snapshot_response_files(root, db):
    """Select every retained source referenced by this exact SQLite snapshot."""
    tables = {row[0] for row in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")}
    if "sf_analysis_response_sources" not in tables:
        return []
    selected = {}
    for (record,) in db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_analysis_response_sources ORDER BY name,revision"):
        source = parse(record.encode())
        if source.get("input_kind") not in {"stream", "mcp"}:
            continue
        folder = _folder(root, _identity(source))
        if not os.path.lexists(folder):
            continue
        _, files = inspect_response(folder, source)
        for row in files:
            _need(row["path"] not in selected or selected[row["path"]] == row,
                  "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT")
            selected[row["path"]] = row
    return [selected[key] for key in sorted(selected)]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--checkout")
    parser.add_argument("--node", default="node")
    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    group.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="Retain every registered stream and MCP revision")
    group.add_argument("--name", help="Original response registration name")
    parser.add_argument("--revision", type=int, help="Exact original revision; required with --name")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    _need((args.all and args.revision is None) or
          (args.name and type(args.revision) is int and args.revision > 0),
          "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
    from .analysis_workspace import AnalysisWorkspace
    workspace = AnalysisWorkspace(args.database, checkout=args.checkout, node=args.node)
    try:
        with workspace.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN")
            records = [parse(row[0].encode()) for row in db.execute(
                "SELECT record FROM sf_analysis_response_sources ORDER BY name,revision")]
        if args.name:
            records = [x for x in records if x["name"] == args.name and x["revision"] == args.revision]
            _need(len(records) == 1, "ANALYSIS_RESPONSE_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND")
        selected = [x for x in records if x.get("input_kind") in {"stream", "mcp"}]
        _need(args.all or len(selected) == 1, "ANALYSIS_RETAINED_RESPONSE_KIND_UNSUPPORTED")
        results = [{"name":x["name"], "revision":x["revision"],
                    **retain_response(workspace.database.directory, x, checkout=workspace.checkout, node=workspace.node)}
                   for x in selected]
        print(_json({"schema": SCHEMA, "sources": results,
                     "other_source_kinds": sorted({x.get("input_kind", x.get("kind", "unknown"))
                                                  for x in records if x not in selected})}).decode(), end="")
    finally:
        workspace.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.worldbank-analysis.v1"
MAX_PACKAGE = 32 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_DOCUMENT = 32 * 1024 * 1024
REQUIRED = {
    "source_id", "country_iso3", "country_name", "indicator_id", "indicator_name",
    "period", "value", "value_state", "unit", "obs_status", "aggregate",
}

def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                       separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()


def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def regular(path, maximum=MAX_PACKAGE):
    path = Path(path).expanduser().absolute()
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), "Select an original regular file: " + str(path))
        require(before.st_size <= maximum, "The selected file exceeds its supported byte capacity.")
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        require((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns),
                "The selected source changed while it was read.")
        require(len(raw) == after.st_size and len(raw) <= maximum,
                "The selected source was not read completely.")
    named = path.lstat()
    require((named.st_dev, named.st_ino, named.st_size, named.st_mtime_ns) ==
            (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns),
            "The selected source path changed.")
    return raw


def sync_directory(path):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def write(path, raw, *, exact=False):
    path = Path(path)
    private_directory(path.parent, create=True)
    if path.exists():
        require(not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file(),
                "Retain the original ordinary operation file: " + str(path))
        if exact:
            require(regular(path, max(len(raw), MAX_DOCUMENT)) == raw,
                    "An existing operation file selects different original bytes: " + path.name)
            return
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".worldbank-", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o600)
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        if exact:
            try:
                os.link(temporary, path, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileExistsError:
                require(regular(path, max(len(raw), MAX_DOCUMENT)) == raw,
                        "Concurrent operation source differs.")
        else:
            os.replace(temporary, path)
        sync_directory(path.parent)
    finally:
        Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)


def describe(path):
    path = Path(path)
    raw = regular(path, 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
    return {"filename": path.name, "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw)}


def sql_identifier(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and value and "\0" not in value,
            "Use a retained SQL column name.")
    return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'


def core_call(core, directory, action, data=None):
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-B", str(core), "--workspace", str(directory), "--action", action],
        input=encoded(data or {}), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        env={**os.environ, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}, check=False)
    try:
        result = json.loads(completed.stdout)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
        raise ValueError("The original World Bank source operation returned no complete JSON result.") from None
    if completed.returncode or "error" in result:
        problem = result.get("error", {})
        raise ValueError("World Bank " + action + ": " +
                         str(problem.get("message", problem.get("code", completed.returncode))))
    return result


def typed_rows(raw, specification):
    csv.field_size_limit(1024 * 1024)
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw.decode("utf-8"), newline=""))
    columns = reader.fieldnames
    require(columns and len(columns) == len(set(columns)),
            "The reviewed source CSV needs distinct original columns.")
    require(specification.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.csv-dataset.v1"
            and set(columns) == set(specification["columns"]),
            "The original dataset schema and CSV columns differ.")
    missing = sorted(REQUIRED - set(columns))
    require(not missing, "Review the source with the Analysis columns included: " + ", ".join(missing))
    rows = []
    for original in reader:
        require(set(original) == set(columns) and all(v is not None for v in original.values()),
                "An original CSV row has a different field count.")
        row = {}
        for name, value in original.items():
            descriptor = specification["columns"][name]
            kind = descriptor.get("type") if isinstance(descriptor, dict) else descriptor
            nullable = isinstance(descriptor, dict) and descriptor.get("nullable") is True
            if nullable and value == "":
                row[name] = None
            elif kind == "string":
                row[name] = value
            elif kind == "boolean":
                require(value in {"true", "false"}, "Retain the original source boolean value.")
                row[name] = value == "true"
            elif kind == "integer":
                require(re.fullmatch(r"-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)", value) is not None,
                        "Retain the original source integer value.")
                row[name] = int(value)
            else:
                raise ValueError("Use the original World Bank scalar schema: " + str(kind))
        rows.append(row)
    return columns, rows

    table = sql_identifier(view)
    original = ", ".join(
        ("CASE " + sql_identifier(c) + " WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END AS " + sql_identifier(c))
        if c == "aggregate" else sql_identifier(c) for c in columns)

), previous AS (

    result = [
        {"key": "observations", "title": "Reviewed observations", "sheet": "Observations",

         "sql": raw_sql, "numeric": {"source_page", "source_row"}},
        {"key": "coverage", "title": "Source coverage", "sheet": "Coverage",
         "note": "Coverage includes missing values and aggregate rows. First and last periods are original source labels. Missing observations are not filled.",
         "sql": coverage, "numeric": {"observations", "missing_observations"}},
        {"key": "annual_change", "title": "Annual change", "sheet": "Annual change",
         "note": "Changes use only four-digit annual periods and consecutive selected years. Missing values, duplicate period identities, nonconsecutive years and zero prior values remain uncalculated. Percentages use SQLite floating point; both original value strings remain alongside them.",
         "sql": changes, "numeric": {"previous_year", "annual_change_percent"}},
    ]
    indicators = {row["indicator_id"] for row in rows}
    if {GDP, POPULATION}.issubset(indicators):
        per_person = """WITH selected AS (
 SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY source_id,country_iso3,indicator_id,period,aggregate) AS identity_rows
 FROM """ + table + """
)
SELECT g.source_id,g.country_iso3,g.country_name,g.period,
 g.value AS gdp_current_usd_source,p.value AS population_source,
 CASE WHEN g.value IS NOT NULL AND p.value IS NOT NULL
       AND g.value_state='present' AND p.value_state='present'
       AND CAST(p.value AS REAL)>0
      THEN CAST(g.value AS REAL)/CAST(p.value AS REAL) ELSE NULL END AS gdp_usd_per_person,

 CASE g.aggregate WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END AS aggregate
FROM selected g JOIN selected p
 ON p.source_id=g.source_id AND p.country_iso3=g.country_iso3
 AND p.period=g.period AND p.aggregate=g.aggregate
WHERE g.indicator_id='NY.GDP.MKTP.CD' AND p.indicator_id='SP.POP.TOTL'

ORDER BY g.source_id,g.country_iso3,g.period"""

                       "note": "Unique reviewed current-US-dollar GDP and population rows join on source, country, period and aggregate status. Duplicate identities remain in Observations and are omitted from this ratio. GDP per person is a derived ratio using SQLite floating point; the two source values remain exact text. It is distinct from purchasing-power-parity measures.",
                       "sql": per_person, "numeric": {"gdp_usd_per_person"}})

class WorldBankAnalysis:
    def __init__(self, workspace, *, operation_id, progress=None, active_workspace=None):
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{32}", operation_id) is not None,
                "Use a stable 32-character lowercase hexadecimal operation ID.")
        self.workspace = private_directory(Path(workspace).expanduser().absolute(), create=True)
        self.operation_id = operation_id
        self.active_workspace = active_workspace
        self.directory = private_directory(
            self.workspace / "worldbank-analysis" / operation_id, create=True)
        self.progress = progress or (lambda value: None)
        path = self.directory / "operation.json"
        self.record = json.loads(regular(path, MAX_DOCUMENT)) if path.exists() else {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": operation_id, "jobs": {}, "queries": {},
        }
        require(self.record.get("schema") == SCHEMA and
                self.record.get("operation_id") == operation_id,
                "Continue the original World Bank Analysis operation.")

    @contextmanager
    def _workspace_session(self):
        if self.active_workspace is not None:
            workspace = self.active_workspace
            require(workspace.database.directory == self.workspace and not workspace._closed,
                    "Continue the same live Analysis workspace owner.")
            yield workspace
        else:
            workspace = AnalysisWorkspace(self.workspace)
            try:
                yield workspace
            finally:
                workspace.close()

    def save(self):
        write(self.directory / "operation.json", encoded(self.record))

    def emit(self, phase, **details):
        self.progress({"operation_id": self.operation_id, "phase": phase, **details})

    def identifier(self, name):
        return sha((self.operation_id + "\0" + name).encode())[:32]

    def job(self, workspace, phase, kind, payload, *, resume=False):
        attempts = self.record["jobs"].setdefault(phase, [])
        expected = sha(encoded({"kind": kind, "request": payload}))
        if not attempts:
            attempts.append({"id": self.identifier("job:" + phase + ":0"),
                             "kind": kind, "request_sha256": expected})
            self.save()
        chosen = attempts[-1]
        require(chosen["kind"] == kind and chosen["request_sha256"] == expected,
                "The original " + phase + " job selects different source inputs.")
        request = {"id": chosen["id"], **payload}
        try:
            current = workspace.job(chosen["id"])
        except StateError as error:
            if (getattr(error, "code", None) or str(error)) != "ANALYSIS_JOB_NOT_FOUND":
                raise
            current = None
        if current and current["status"] in {"FAILED", "INTERRUPTED", "CANCELLED"}:
            require(resume, phase + " needs its original continuation; run prepare with --resume. " +
                    str(current.get("error") or current["status"]))
            if kind != "workspace-export":
                chosen = {"id": self.identifier("job:" + phase + ":" + str(len(attempts))),
                          "kind": kind, "request_sha256": expected}
                attempts.append(chosen)
                self.save()
                request["id"] = chosen["id"]
        self.emit(phase, job_id=chosen["id"])
        current = workspace.start(kind, request)
        while current["status"] == "RUNNING":
            time.sleep(0.05)
            current = workspace.job(chosen["id"])
        require(current["status"] == "COMPLETE",
                phase + " stopped: " + str(current.get("error") or current["status"]))
        return current

    def completed(self):
        result = self.record.get("result")
        if not result:
            return None
        for item in result["files"]:
            path = self.directory / "delivery" / item["filename"]
            require(describe(path) == item, "A completed customer delivery file changed: " + item["filename"])
        return result

    def prepare(self, handover, core, *, prefix="worldbank", resume=False):
        import fcntl
        descriptor = os.open(self.directory, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            path = self.directory / "operation.json"
            if path.exists():
                self.record = json.loads(regular(path, MAX_DOCUMENT))
                require(self.record.get("operation_id") == self.operation_id and
                        self.record.get("schema") == SCHEMA,
                        "Continue the original selected Analysis operation.")
            return self._prepare(handover, core, prefix=prefix, resume=resume)
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)

    def _prepare(self, handover, core, *, prefix="worldbank", resume=False):
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,20}", prefix) is not None,
                "Use a short Analysis name containing letters, digits and underscores.")
        core = Path(core).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
        require(core.name == "core.py" and (core.parent / "source.py").is_file(),
                "Select the original World Bank core.py and its source.py sibling.")
        raw = regular(handover, MAX_PACKAGE)
        intent = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": self.operation_id,
            "handover": {"bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw)},
            "source_engine": {"core_sha256": sha(regular(core)),
                              "source_sha256": sha(regular(core.parent / "source.py"))},
            "prefix": prefix,
            "transform_sha256": sha(inspect.getsource(typed_rows).encode()),
        }
        write(self.directory / "intent.json", encoded(intent), exact=True)
        self._source_file = core.parent / "source.py"
        self._source_sha256 = intent["source_engine"]["source_sha256"]
        ready = self.completed()
        if ready:
            self.emit("COMPLETE", rows=ready["source"]["observations"], reused=True)
            return ready
        write(self.directory / "original-handover.zip", raw, exact=True)
        native = self.directory / "worldbank"
        capture_id, review_id, export_id = "analysis-source", "analysis-review", "analysis-edition"
        self.emit("SOURCE_REVIEW")
        state = core_call(core, native, "state")
        capture = next((r for r in state["captures"] if r["id"] == capture_id), None)
        reviewed = next((r for r in state["reviews"] if r["id"] == review_id), None)
        if not (capture and capture.get("status") == "COMPLETE" and reviewed and
                reviewed.get("captureId") == capture_id and
                reviewed.get("captureSha256") == capture.get("captureSha256")):
            imported = core_call(core, native, "import-package", {
                "id": capture_id, "reviewId": review_id, "selectionId": "analysis-selection",
                "archiveBase64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode()})
            require(imported["originalPackageSha256"] == intent["handover"]["sha256"],
                    "The native source importer selected another handover.")
            capture, reviewed = imported["capture"], imported["review"]
        exported = core_call(core, native, "export", {
            "id": export_id, "reviewId": review_id, "expectedRevision": reviewed["revision"]})
        export_root = Path(exported["directory"])
        regenerated = regular(export_root / "dataset.csv", MAX_DOCUMENT)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
            original = {name: archive.read(name) for name in (
                "dataset.csv", "dataset.json", "source.json", "review.json",
                "selection.json", "original/capture.json")}
        source = json.loads(original["source.json"])
        review = json.loads(original["review.json"])
        require(regenerated == original["dataset.csv"],
                "The reviewed source rows differ from the original customer CSV.")
        require(all(review.get(k) == reviewed.get(k) for k in REVIEW_FIELDS)
                and review["captureSha256"] == source["captureSha256"]
                and reviewed["captureSha256"] == capture["captureSha256"],
                "The retained receiving review differs from the original source review.")
        specification = json.loads(regular(export_root / "dataset.json"))
        columns, rows = typed_rows(regenerated, specification)
        require(len(rows) == review["includedObservations"] == source["observations"],
                "The original review, source and projected row counts differ.")
        require(len(rows) < 100_000, "Select fewer than 100,000 reviewed observations for this complete report.")
        projection = encoded({"observations": rows})
        require(len(projection) <= MAX_DOCUMENT,
                "The typed Analysis source exceeds the original 32 MiB JSON document capacity.")
        document = private_directory(self.directory / "source-document", create=True)

        def content(body, extension, mime):
            path = "files/" + sha(body) + "." + extension
            write(document / path, body, exact=True)
            return {"path": path, "bytes": len(body), "sha256": sha(body), "contentType": mime}

        original_files = [{**content(raw, "bin", "application/zip"), "role": "original-worldbank-handover"}]
        seen = {original_files[0]["path"]}
        for name, body in original.items():
            extension = "csv" if name.endswith(".csv") else "json"
            descriptor = content(body, extension, "text/csv" if extension == "csv" else "application/json")
            if descriptor["path"] not in seen:
                original_files.append({**descriptor, "role": "original-" + name.replace("/", "-")})
                seen.add(descriptor["path"])
        manifest = {
            "schema": "stellar-forge.analysis-source-document.v1",
            "title": review["title"][:200], "format": "json",
            "document": content(projection, "json", "application/json"),
            "originals": original_files,
            "provenance": {
                "kind": "public-source", "publisher": "World Bank",
                "sourceUrl": "https://api.worldbank.org/v2",
                "capturedAt": source["capturedAt"],
                "scope": ("Source " + source["sourceId"] + "; " + str(len(source["selection"]["countries"])) +
                          " countries; " + str(len(source["selection"]["indicators"])) +
                          " indicators; period " + source["selection"]["date"] +
                          ". Complete original selection retained in this document."),
                "description": "Reviewed original World Bank observations. " + review["note"],
                "transform": {
                    "name": "worldbank_analysis.typed_rows source function v1",
                    "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/public-commons-sprint-2026/blob/main/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/python/stellar_forge_buyer/worldbank_analysis.py",
                    "sha256": intent["transform_sha256"],
                },
            },
            "complete": True,
        }
        write(document / "source.json", encoded(manifest), exact=True)
        name = prefix + "_" + self.operation_id[:12]
        selected_recipes = recipes(name, columns, rows)
        max_rows = max(1000, len(rows) + 1)
        self.record["adapter_sha256"] = sha(regular(Path(__file__), MAX_DOCUMENT))
        self.record["source"] = {
            "handover": intent["handover"], "observations": len(rows),
            "capture_sha256": source["captureSha256"], "selection": source["selection"],
            "captured_at": source["capturedAt"], "review_id": review["id"],
            "review_revision": review["revision"], "title": review["title"],
            "dataset_csv_sha256": sha(regenerated), "typed_source_sha256": sha(projection),
        }
        self.save()
        with self._workspace_session() as workspace:
            return self._prepare_analysis(workspace, document, name, source, review,
                rows, columns, selected_recipes, max_rows, resume=resume)


    def _prepare_analysis(self, workspace, document, name, source, review,
                          rows, columns, selected_recipes, max_rows, *, resume):
        registered = workspace.responses.register(name, "document", manifest=document / "source.json")
        preview = self.job(workspace, "SOURCE_PREVIEW", "response-preview", {
            "source": name, "source_revision": registered["revision"],
            "mapping": {"collection": "/observations", "sse_data": "text",
                        "columns": [{"name": c, "pointer": "/" + c, "type": "native", "missing": "error"}
                                    for c in columns]}}, resume=resume)
        imported = self.job(workspace, "SOURCE_IMPORT", "response-import", {
            "preview_id": preview["id"], "preview_sha256": preview["result"]["preview_sha256"],
            "allow_incomplete": False}, resume=resume)
        version = imported["result"]["version"]
        require(version["row_count"] == len(rows), "The retained Analysis table row count differs.")
        current = workspace.database.current(name)
        if current["version"] is not None:
            require(current["version"]["version_id"] == version["version_id"],
                    "The original Analysis view now selects another customer edition.")
        selected_view = workspace.database.activate(name, version["version_id"],
                                                    expected_revision=current["revision"])
        self.record["version_id"] = version["version_id"]
        self.record["view"] = {"name": name, "revision": selected_view["revision"]}
        query_records = []
        for recipe in selected_recipes:
            query_name = name + "_" + recipe["key"]
            fields = {"sql": recipe["sql"], "parameters_text": "[]", "max_rows": max_rows}
            if query_name in self.record["queries"]:
                saved = workspace.saved_query(query_name, revision=self.record["queries"][query_name])
                require(all(saved[k] == v for k, v in fields.items()),
                        "The retained query revision differs from its original source recipe.")
            else:
                try:
                    saved = workspace.saved_query(query_name)
                except StateError as error:
                    if (getattr(error, "code", None) or str(error)) != "ANALYSIS_QUERY_NOT_FOUND":
                        raise
                    saved = workspace.save_query(query_name, fields, expected_revision=0)
                require(all(saved[k] == v for k, v in fields.items()),
                        "An existing query name contains another customer recipe.")
                self.record["queries"][query_name] = saved["revision"]
                self.save()
            query_records.append(saved)
        report_name = name + "_report"
        report_definition = workspace.reports.save(report_name, {
            "id": self.identifier("report-definition"), "expected_revision": 0,
            "title": (review["title"] + " — Analysis")[:200],
            "introduction": "Original reviewed World Bank source " + source["sourceId"] +
                ". Source numeric text and period labels are retained. Derived calculations are identified in their sections.",
            "sections": [{"title": recipe["title"], "note": recipe["note"],
                          "query_name": saved["name"], "query_revision": saved["revision"],
                          "parameters_text": None}
                         for recipe, saved in zip(selected_recipes, query_records)]})
        definition = workspace.reports.definition(report_name, revision=report_definition["revision"])
        if "report_views" not in self.record:
            self.record["report_views"] = workspace.database.view_bindings()
            self.save()
        report = self.job(workspace, "REPORT", "report", {
            "name": report_name, "revision": report_definition["revision"],
            "definition_sha256": definition["sha256"],
            "expected_views": self.record["report_views"]}, resume=resume)
        if "publication_revision" not in self.record:
            self.record["publication_revision"] = definition["publication_revision"]
            self.save()
        publication = workspace.reports.publish(report["id"], {
            "id": self.identifier("report-publication"),
            "result_sha256": report["result"]["result_sha256"],
            "expected_revision": self.record["publication_revision"],
            "note": "Complete reviewed source and reproducible country/indicator analysis."})
        first_source = workspace.workbooks.source({"kind": "report", "id": publication["id"], "section": 0})
        publication_sha = first_source["sha256"]
        self.record["publication"] = {**publication, "sha256": publication_sha}
        self.save()
        sheets = []
        for index, recipe in enumerate(selected_recipes):
            selected = workspace.workbooks.source({"kind": "report", "id": publication["id"], "section": index})
            labels = selected["columns"]
            if labels and isinstance(labels[0], dict):
                labels = [c["name"] for c in labels]
            require(all(isinstance(c, str) for c in labels), "Use the original published report columns.")
            sheets.append({
                "name": recipe["sheet"],
                "source": {"kind": "report", "id": publication["id"],
                           "sha256": selected["sha256"], "section": index},
                "columns": [{"source": c, "source_index": i, "header": c,
                             "type": ("number" if c in {"annual_change_percent", "gdp_usd_per_person"} else
                                      "integer" if c in recipe["numeric"] else "text"),
                             "null": "blank" if c in recipe["numeric"] else "text",
                             "null_text": "NULL",
                             "precision": "excel-number" if c in {"annual_change_percent", "gdp_usd_per_person"} else "preserve"}
                            for i, c in enumerate(labels)],
            })
        workbook_name = name + "_workbook"
        workbook_definition = workspace.workbooks.save(workbook_name, {
            "id": self.identifier("workbook-definition"), "expected_revision": 0,
            "title": review["title"][:200], "notes": "Original source values are text. Counts and explicitly derived calculations are numeric. Missing source text is NULL; uncalculated numeric cells are blank.",
            "sheets": sheets})
        workbook = self.job(workspace, "WORKBOOK", "workbook", {
            "name": workbook_name, "revision": workbook_definition["revision"],
            "definition_sha256": workbook_definition["definition_sha256"]}, resume=resume)
        return self._deliver(workspace, source, review, len(rows), version, publication,
                             publication_sha, workbook, resume=resume)

    def _deliver(self, workspace, source, review, row_count, version, publication,
                 publication_sha, workbook, *, resume=False, extra_files=()):
        """Use the original complete delivery route for first and recurring editions."""
        destination = private_directory(self.directory / "delivery", create=True)
