        def download(manager, job_id, source_name, output_name):
            with manager.download(job_id, source_name) as (stream, descriptor):
                data = stream.read()
            require(len(data) == descriptor["bytes"] and sha(data) == descriptor["sha256"],
                    "The original download differs from its declared complete file.")
            path = destination / output_name
            write(path, data, exact=True)
            return describe(path)

        files = [
            download(workspace.workbooks, workbook["id"], "workbook.xlsx", "WorldBank_Analysis.xlsx"),
            download(workspace.workbooks, workbook["id"], "handoff.zip", "WorldBank_Workbook_Handover.zip"),
        ]
        files.extend(extra_files)
        for format, filename in (("html", "WorldBank_Report.html"), ("json", "WorldBank_Report.json"),
                                 ("csv", "WorldBank_Report_Tables.zip")):
            report_export = self.job(workspace, "REPORT_" + format.upper(), "report-export", {
                "publication_id": publication["id"], "publication_sha256": publication_sha,
                "format": format}, resume=resume)
            path, descriptor = workspace.report_export_file(report_export["id"])
            body = regular(path, 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
            require(len(body) == descriptor["bytes"] and sha(body) == descriptor["sha256"],
                    "The original published report download changed.")
            write(destination / filename, body, exact=True)
            files.append(describe(destination / filename))
        availability = workspace.archives.review(include_previous_backups=False)
        require(availability["ready"], "Complete the retained Analysis outputs before workspace delivery: " +
                json.dumps(availability.get("missing", [])))
        archived = self.job(workspace, "WORKSPACE_ARCHIVE", "workspace-export", {
            "include_previous_backups": False}, resume=resume)
        files.append(download(workspace.archives, archived["id"], "workspace.zip", "WorldBank_Analysis_Workspace.zip"))
        files.append(download(workspace.archives, archived["id"], "archive-manifest.json", "WorldBank_Analysis_Workspace_Manifest.json"))
        guide = self.guide(source, review, publication, archived["result"])
        write(destination / "Open_and_use.md", guide.encode(), exact=True)
        files.append(describe(destination / "Open_and_use.md"))
        result = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": self.operation_id, "status": "COMPLETE",
            "source": self.record["source"], "version_id": version["version_id"],
            "view": self.record["view"], "report": self.record["publication"],
            "workbook": {"job_id": workbook["id"], "manifest_sha256": workbook["result"]["manifest_sha256"],
                         "rows": workbook["result"]["row_count"]},
            "workspace": {"id": archived["result"]["id"],
                          "workspace_id": archived["result"]["workspace_id"]},
            "files": files,
        }
        write(destination / "Analysis_Delivery.json", encoded(result), exact=True)
        files = [*files, describe(destination / "Analysis_Delivery.json")]
        bundle = destination / "WorldBank_Analysis_Delivery.zip"
        self.bundle(bundle, destination, files)
        result["files"] = [*files, describe(bundle)]
        self.record["result"] = result
        self.save()
        self.emit("COMPLETE", rows=row_count, files=len(result["files"]))
        return result

    def guide(self, source, review, publication, archived):
        fence = chr(96) * 3
        return """# World Bank Analysis

""" + review["title"] + """

Open **WorldBank_Report.html** for the complete published analysis, or
**WorldBank_Analysis.xlsx** for the Excel workbook. The workbook contains
reviewed observations, source coverage, consecutive annual changes and, when
both original series are present, GDP divided by population.

## Source and numeric values

The original World Bank handover and its reviewed CSV, source metadata, review
and capture are retained inside the Analysis source document. Original number
tokens and period labels remain text. Counts and derived calculations use numeric
cells; calculated percentages and ratios use SQLite floating point. Source
values remain alongside the calculations. Missing source text appears as NULL; uncalculated numeric cells are blank. Both
remain nullable in the Analysis database.

GDP uses the original current-US-dollar series. GDP per person is a derived ratio
and is distinct from purchasing-power-parity or constant-price measures.

## Continue in the original Analysis application

Install the existing Python workbook extra, then receive the complete workspace
into a new private directory:

""" + fence + """sh
stellar-forge-worldbank-analysis receive --archive /absolute/WorldBank_Analysis_Workspace.zip \\
  --sha256 <workspace-ZIP-SHA256-from-Analysis_Delivery.json> \\
  --workspace /absolute/private/worldbank-analysis \\
  --operation-id <stable-32-character-lowercase-hex-id>
stellar-forge-worldbank-analysis serve --workspace /absolute/private/worldbank-analysis
""" + fence + """

The command prints a private local browser URL. Open that URL to use the original
sources, typed tables, saved SQL recipes, report publication and workbook history.
The workbook ZIP can also be received independently through the existing
WorkbookDelivery API. Exact original publication, workbook and source hashes
are included in Analysis_Delivery.json.

Use the same receiving operation and archive hash to continue an interrupted
workspace delivery. A completed receive preserves subsequent customer edits.
For another approved edition of the same customer monitoring workbook, use the
recurring-review / recurring-refresh workflow with the same saved view, report
and workbook names. Use a separate prepare operation and view for an independent
analysis.

## Retained source edition

- Source: World Bank Indicators API V2; source """ + source["sourceId"] + """
- Original capture time: """ + source["capturedAt"] + """
- Reviewed observations: """ + str(source["observations"]) + """
- Original review: """ + review["id"] + " revision " + str(review["revision"]) + """
- Published report: """ + publication["id"] + """
- Analysis workspace: """ + archived["workspace_id"] + """
"""

    def bundle(self, path, directory, files):
        fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".worldbank-delivery-", dir=directory)
        os.close(fd)
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
                for item in sorted(files, key=lambda row: row["filename"]):
                    body = regular(directory / item["filename"], 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
                    require(len(body) == item["bytes"] and sha(body) == item["sha256"],
                            "A selected customer delivery file changed during assembly.")
                    info = zipfile.ZipInfo(item["filename"], (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                    info.create_system = 3
                    info.external_attr = 0o100600 << 16
                    info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                    archive.writestr(info, body)
            write(path, regular(temporary, 1024 * 1024 * 1024), exact=True)
        finally:
            Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    prepare = commands.add_parser("prepare", help="Prepare the complete reviewed source, report, workbook and portable workspace")
    prepare.add_argument("--handover", required=True)
    prepare.add_argument("--worldbank-core", required=True, help="Original World Bank core.py beside its source.py")
    prepare.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    prepare.add_argument("--operation-id", help="Stable 32-character lowercase hexadecimal operation ID; defaults to the handover digest")
    prepare.add_argument("--prefix", default="worldbank")
    prepare.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true", help="Continue an interrupted original phase while retaining prior job results")
    receive = commands.add_parser("receive", help="Receive the complete portable Analysis workspace")
    receive.add_argument("--archive", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--sha256", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--operation-id", required=True)
    launch = commands.add_parser("serve", help="Open the original private Analysis application")
    launch.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    launch.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=0)
    status = commands.add_parser("status", help="Read a retained World Bank Analysis delivery")
    status.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    status.add_argument("--operation-id", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "receive":
            from .workspace_archive_receive import restore_archive
            value = restore_archive(args.archive, args.workspace,
                                    operation=args.operation_id, expected_sha256=args.sha256)
        elif args.command == "serve":
            workspace = AnalysisWorkspace(args.workspace)
            server, control, url = serve(workspace, port=args.port)
            try:
                print(json.dumps({"url": url, "workspace_id": workspace.identity}), flush=True)
                server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.2)
            finally:
                server.server_close()
                workspace.close()
                control.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            return 0
        else:
            operation = args.operation_id or sha(regular(args.handover))[:32]
            current = WorldBankAnalysis(args.workspace, operation_id=operation,
                progress=lambda event: print(json.dumps(event), flush=True))
            if args.command == "status":
                value = current.completed() or current.record
            else:
                value = current.prepare(args.handover, args.worldbank_core,
                                        prefix=args.prefix, resume=args.resume)
        print(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        return 130
    except (BuyerError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"schema": SCHEMA, "error": str(error)}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Approved World Bank handover intake on the original running Analysis owner.

Chunked intake retains exact bytes and stable requests; the original
WorldBankAnalysis source importer and typed projection validate the document.
Registration does not select a view or run a report/workbook.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import binascii
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import threading

from .errors import StateError
from .storage import private_directory
from .response_documents import document_path, validate_manifest, _delivery
from .worldbank_analysis import WorldBankAnalysis, encoded, regular, write, sha, MAX_PACKAGE

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.worldbank-intake.v1"
CHUNK_BYTES = 256 * 1024
_ID = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{32}")
_HASH = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{64}")


def need(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise StateError("WORLDBANK_INTAKE_" + code)


def identifier(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and _ID.fullmatch(value), "ID_REQUIRED")
    return value


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


class _Registration(WorldBankAnalysis):
    """Override only the original post-projection registration hook."""

    def _prepare_analysis(self, workspace, document, name, source, review,
                          rows, columns, selected_recipes, max_rows, *, resume):
        # Use the complete operation ID; the browser cannot choose an existing
        # source name or overwrite a customer's source revision.
        name = "worldbank_intake_" + self.operation_id
        manifest = document / "source.json"
        expected_document = sha(regular(manifest))
        with workspace.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            existing = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_analysis_sources WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
        if existing:
            registered = json.loads(existing[0])
            need(registered.get("input_kind") == "document" and
                 registered.get("document_id") == expected_document, "REGISTERED_SOURCE_CHANGED")
            # Reopen the retained original source; existence alone is insufficient.
            with workspace.responses._open(registered).file.open():
                pass
        else:
            registered = workspace.responses.register(name, "document", manifest=manifest, expected_revision=0)
        value = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "id": self.operation_id, "status": "REGISTERED",
            "workspace_id": workspace.identity,
            "source": {"name": registered["name"], "revision": registered["revision"],
                       "document_id": registered["document_id"]},
            "handover": self.record["source"]["handover"],
            "observations": len(rows), "columns": columns,
            "source_metadata": source, "original_review": review,
            "registered_at": now(),
        }
        # This is separate from WorldBankAnalysis.result's complete delivery contract.
        path = self.directory / "intake-registration.json"
        if path.exists():
            retained = json.loads(regular(path))
            need(all(retained.get(key) == value[key] for key in
                     ("schema", "id", "status", "workspace_id", "source", "handover",
                      "observations", "columns", "source_metadata", "original_review")),
                 "REGISTRATION_CHANGED")
            return retained
        write(path, encoded(value), exact=True)
        return value


class WorldBankIntake:
    def __init__(self, workspace, *, core):
        self.workspace = workspace
        self.database = workspace.database
        # Generic Analysis can open without the separately installed seller core.
        # The original importer validates that executable source on registration.
        self.core = Path(core).expanduser().absolute()
        need(self.core.name == "core.py", "ORIGINAL_INSTALLED_CORE_REQUIRED")
        self.directory = private_directory(self.database.directory / "worldbank-intake", create=True)
        self._mutex = threading.RLock()
        self._closed = False
        self._active = None
        with self.database._connection() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_worldbank_intakes("
                       "sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL)")
            for row in db.execute("SELECT id,record FROM sf_worldbank_intakes").fetchall():
                value = json.loads(row["record"])
                if value["status"] == "REGISTERING":
                    value.update(status="INTERRUPTED", error="Continue the same approved handover registration.",
                                 updated_at=now())
                    db.execute("UPDATE sf_worldbank_intakes SET record=? WHERE id=?",
                               (encoded(value).decode(), row["id"]))
            db.commit()
        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="worldbank-intake")

    def close(self):
        with self._mutex:
            self._closed = True
        # Drain before the owning AnalysisWorkspace closes its jobs and sources.
        self._executor.shutdown(wait=True)

    def _load(self, intake_id):
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_worldbank_intakes WHERE id=?",
                             (identifier(intake_id),)).fetchone()
        need(row is not None, "NOT_FOUND")
        return json.loads(row[0])

    def _store(self, value):
        value["updated_at"] = now()
        with self.database._connection() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE sf_worldbank_intakes SET record=? WHERE id=?",
                       (encoded(value).decode(), value["id"]))

    def _root(self, intake_id):
        return private_directory(self.directory / identifier(intake_id), create=True)

    def _retained_original(self, value):
        need(value["status"] == "REGISTERED", "REGISTERED_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
        selected = value["result"]["source"]
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            source = self.workspace.responses._source(db, selected["name"], selected["revision"])
        need(source.get("document_id") == selected["document_id"], "REGISTERED_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        manifest_path = document_path(self.database.directory, source["document_id"])
        raw = regular(manifest_path, 1024 * 1024)
        need(sha(raw) == selected["document_id"], "DOCUMENT_CHANGED")
        manifest = validate_manifest(json.loads(raw))
        original = next((item for item in manifest["originals"]
                         if item["role"] == "original-worldbank-handover"), None)
        need(original is not None and original["bytes"] == value["intent"]["bytes"]
             and original["sha256"] == value["intent"]["sha256"], "ORIGINAL_CHANGED")
        return _delivery(manifest_path.parent, original), original

    def status(self, intake_id):
        value = self._load(intake_id)
        # A portable Analysis archive carries registered documents and this SQL
        # history. Upload fragments are local staging and may need the same file
        # after an interrupted workspace is restored into another installation.
        if value["status"] != "REGISTERED":
            root = self._root(intake_id)
            available = 0
            for chunk in value["chunks"]:
                path = root / ("chunk-" + str(chunk["offset"]).zfill(12))
                if not path.exists():
                    break
                body = regular(path, CHUNK_BYTES)
                need(len(body) == chunk["bytes"] and sha(body) == chunk["sha256"],
                     "RETAINED_CHUNK_CHANGED")
                available += len(body)
            value["available_bytes"] = available
            value["needs_original_file"] = available < value["intent"]["bytes"]
        else:
            delivery, _ = self._retained_original(value)
            with delivery.open():
                pass
            value["available_bytes"] = value["intent"]["bytes"]
            value["needs_original_file"] = False
        return {**value, "chunk_bytes": CHUNK_BYTES, "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity}

    def history(self, *, before=None, limit=25):
        need(type(limit) is int and 1 <= limit <= 100 and
             (before is None or type(before) is int and before > 0), "PAGE_INVALID")
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT sequence,record FROM sf_worldbank_intakes "
                "WHERE (? IS NULL OR sequence<?) ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT ?",
                (before, before, limit + 1)).fetchall()
        return {"schema": SCHEMA, "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity,
                "intakes": [json.loads(row["record"]) for row in rows[:limit]],
                "next_before": rows[limit-1]["sequence"] if len(rows) > limit else None,
                "chunk_bytes": CHUNK_BYTES, "max_bytes": MAX_PACKAGE}

    def begin(self, request):
        intake_id = identifier(request.get("id"))
        size, digest = request.get("bytes"), request.get("sha256")
        filename = request.get("filename")
        need(type(size) is int and 0 < size <= MAX_PACKAGE, "HANDOVER_SIZE_INVALID")
        need(isinstance(digest, str) and _HASH.fullmatch(digest), "HANDOVER_HASH_REQUIRED")
        need(isinstance(filename, str) and filename and len(filename.encode()) <= 240
             and "/" not in filename and "\\" not in filename
             and all(ord(c) >= 32 and ord(c) != 127 for c in filename), "FILENAME_INVALID")
        intent = {"bytes": size, "sha256": digest, "filename": filename}
        with self._mutex:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            with self.database._connection() as db:
                db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                old = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_worldbank_intakes WHERE id=?", (intake_id,)).fetchone()
                if old:
                    value = json.loads(old[0])
                    need(value["intent"] == intent, "ID_REUSED")
                else:
                    # Intake IDs share the original World Bank operation namespace.
                    need(not (self.database.directory / "worldbank-analysis" / intake_id).exists(),
                         "OPERATION_ID_ALREADY_USED")
                    value = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": intake_id, "intent": intent,
                             "status": "UPLOADING", "received_bytes": 0, "chunks": [],
                             "attempts": [], "created_at": now(), "updated_at": now()}
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_worldbank_intakes(id,record) VALUES(?,?)",
                               (intake_id, encoded(value).decode()))
                db.commit()
        return self.status(intake_id)

    def chunk(self, intake_id, request):
        need(isinstance(request.get("content"), str) and len(request["content"]) <=
             ((CHUNK_BYTES + 2) // 3) * 4, "CHUNK_SIZE_INVALID")
        try:
            body = base64.b64decode(request["content"], validate=True)
        except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
            raise StateError("WORLDBANK_INTAKE_CHUNK_BASE64_INVALID") from None
        offset, digest = request.get("offset"), request.get("sha256")
        need(type(offset) is int and offset >= 0 and body and len(body) <= CHUNK_BYTES
             and digest == sha(body), "CHUNK_IDENTITY_INVALID")
        with self._mutex:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            value = self._load(intake_id)
            need(value["status"] not in {"REGISTERED", "REGISTERING"}, "UPLOAD_ALREADY_FINISHED")
            need(offset % CHUNK_BYTES == 0 and offset + len(body) <= value["intent"]["bytes"]
                 and (len(body) == CHUNK_BYTES or offset + len(body) == value["intent"]["bytes"]),
                 "CHUNK_POSITION_INVALID")
            record = {"offset": offset, "bytes": len(body), "sha256": digest}
            old = next((x for x in value["chunks"] if x["offset"] == offset), None)
            if old is not None:
                need(old == record, "CHUNK_ID_REUSED")
            else:
                need(offset == value["received_bytes"], "CONTIGUOUS_CHUNK_REQUIRED")
            # Atomic immutable members make a write-before-SQL interruption safe.
            write(self._root(intake_id) / ("chunk-" + str(offset).zfill(12)), body, exact=True)
            if old is None:
                value["chunks"].append(record)
                value["received_bytes"] += len(body)
            value.update(status="UPLOADED" if value["received_bytes"] == value["intent"]["bytes"]
                         else "UPLOADING", error=None)
            self._store(value)
        return {"id": intake_id, "status": value["status"], "received_bytes": value["received_bytes"]}

    def register(self, intake_id, *, resume=False):
        need(type(resume) is bool, "RESUME_INVALID")
        with self._mutex:
            need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            value = self._load(intake_id)
            if value["status"] in {"REGISTERED", "REGISTERING"}:
                return self.status(intake_id)
            need(self._active is None, "BUSY")
            need(value["status"] in {"UPLOADED", "ERROR", "INTERRUPTED"}
                 and value["received_bytes"] == value["intent"]["bytes"], "COMPLETE_UPLOAD_REQUIRED")
            need(value["status"] == "UPLOADED" or resume, "EXPLICIT_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED")
            body = bytearray()
            for chunk in value["chunks"]:
                part = regular(self._root(intake_id) / ("chunk-" + str(chunk["offset"]).zfill(12)), CHUNK_BYTES)
                need(len(body) == chunk["offset"] and len(part) == chunk["bytes"]
                     and sha(part) == chunk["sha256"], "RETAINED_CHUNK_CHANGED")
                body.extend(part)
            need(len(body) == value["intent"]["bytes"] and sha(body) == value["intent"]["sha256"],
                 "FULL_HANDOVER_CHANGED")
            handover = self._root(intake_id) / "handover.zip"
            write(handover, bytes(body), exact=True)
            value.update(status="REGISTERING", error=None)
            value["attempts"].append({"started_at": now(), "status": "REGISTERING"})
            self._store(value)
            self._active = intake_id
            self._executor.submit(self._run, intake_id, handover)
            return value

    def _run(self, intake_id, handover):
        try:
            need(self.core.is_file() and (self.core.parent / "source.py").is_file(),
                 "INSTALLED_ORIGINAL_CORE_REQUIRED")
            def progress(event):
                with self._mutex:
                    value = self._load(intake_id)
                    value["progress"] = event
                    self._store(value)
            # The shared source adapter's active_workspace hook uses the SAME
            # native owner, avoiding another process lease or replacement engine.
            current = _Registration(self.database.directory, operation_id=intake_id,
                                    active_workspace=self.workspace, progress=progress)
            result = current.prepare(handover, self.core, prefix="intake", resume=True)
            need(result.get("status") == "REGISTERED", "SOURCE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED")
            with self._mutex:
                value = self._load(intake_id)
                value.update(status="REGISTERED", result=result, error=None)
                value["attempts"][-1].update(status="REGISTERED", finished_at=now())
                self._store(value)
        except Exception as error:
            with self._mutex:
                value = self._load(intake_id)
                value.update(status="ERROR", error=str(error))
                value["attempts"][-1].update(status="ERROR", error=str(error), finished_at=now())
                self._store(value)
        finally:
            with self._mutex:
                self._active = None

    def original(self, intake_id):
        value = self._load(intake_id)
        delivery, original = self._retained_original(value)
        # Callers use the original descriptor-based delivery.open()/send_export.
        return delivery, {"name": "WorldBank_Approved_Handover.zip",
                          "filename": "WorldBank_Approved_Handover.zip",
                          "mime": "application/zip", "bytes": original["bytes"],
                          "sha256": original["sha256"]}

"""Compare complete retained provider metadata in an original recurring review.

The native World Bank source parser owns exact numeric tokens and duplicate-key
validation. The original source document and handover own all page bytes. This
module compares their metadata without acquiring or rewriting provider data.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
import json
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType
import zipfile

from .response_documents import document_path, validate_manifest, _delivery
from .worldbank_analysis import encoded, regular, require, sha, MAX_DOCUMENT

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.worldbank-metadata-review.v1"
_METADATA = {"sources", "countries", "indicators"}


def _parser(source_file, expected_sha256):
    raw = regular(source_file, MAX_DOCUMENT)
    require(sha(raw) == expected_sha256, "Retain the original reviewed World Bank source parser.")
    module = ModuleType("_worldbank_original_source")
    module.__file__ = str(source_file)
    exec(compile(raw, str(source_file), "exec"), module.__dict__)
    return module


def _typed(value, numeric):
    """Canonical type-aware values, with no numeric conversion or key collision."""
    if isinstance(value, numeric):
        return ["number", str(value)]
    if value is None:
        return ["null"]
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return ["boolean", value]
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return ["string", value]
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return ["array", [_typed(item, numeric) for item in value]]
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "Retain the original JSON metadata value types.")
    return ["object", [[key, _typed(value[key], numeric)] for key in sorted(value)]]


def _numbers(value, numeric, pointer=""):
    result = {}
    if isinstance(value, numeric):
        result[pointer] = str(value)
    elif isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            result.update(_numbers(item, numeric, pointer + "/" + key.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, item in enumerate(value):
            result.update(_numbers(item, numeric, pointer + "/" + str(index)))
    return result


def _edition(workspace, version_id, parser):
    version = workspace.database.version(version_id)
    document_id = version["dataset"].get("response", {}).get("original", {}).get("documentId")
    manifest_path = document_path(workspace.database.directory, document_id)
    manifest_raw = regular(manifest_path, MAX_DOCUMENT)
    require(sha(manifest_raw) == document_id, "Retain the original content-addressed source document.")
    manifest = validate_manifest(json.loads(manifest_raw))
    originals = [item for item in manifest["originals"] if item["role"] == "original-worldbank-handover"]
    require(len(originals) == 1, "Select an original World Bank handover retained by this dataset version.")
    descriptor = originals[0]
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    pages = []
    with _delivery(manifest_path.parent, descriptor).open() as stream:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(stream) as archive:
            names = archive.namelist()
            require(len(names) == len(set(names)), "The retained handover repeats an archive member.")
            def member(name):
                item = archive.getinfo(name)
                require(item.file_size <= MAX_DOCUMENT, "A retained metadata member exceeds the original capacity.")
                return archive.read(item)
            source = json.loads(member("source.json"))
            review = json.loads(member("review.json"))
            selection = json.loads(member("selection.json"))
            capture = json.loads(member("original/capture.json"))
            require(source.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.worldbank-export.v1" and
                    source["captureSha256"] == review["captureSha256"] == capture["captureSha256"] and
                    selection == source["selection"] == capture["spec"],
                    "The original source, capture, selection and review must name the same edition.")
            for page in capture["pages"]:
                require(page["kind"] in _METADATA | {"data"}, "Use a complete original World Bank page kind.")
                retained = {key: page.get(key) for key in (
                    "kind", "page", "indicatorId", "requestGroup", "url", "sha256", "bytes", "pagination")}
                pages.append(retained)
                raw = member("original/" + page["bodyFile"])
                require(len(raw) == page["bytes"] and sha(raw) == page["sha256"],
                        "The retained provider page differs from its original capture.")
                if page["kind"] not in _METADATA:
                    continue
                value = parser.parse_source(raw)
                require(isinstance(value, list) and len(value) == 2 and
                        isinstance(value[0], dict) and (value[1] is None or isinstance(value[1], list)),
                        "The original provider metadata page must contain pagination and rows.")
                for row in value[1] or []:
                    require(isinstance(row, dict), "Retain complete original metadata objects.")
                    # The original engine groups indicator metadata by its
                    # selected indicator. Imported requestGroup labels describe
                    # acquisition and remain in pages, not semantic row identity.
                    indicator = page.get("indicatorId")
                    group = page["kind"] if indicator is None else "indicators:" + indicator.upper()
                    identity = [page["kind"], indicator.upper() if indicator is not None else None, group,
                                _typed(row.get("id"), parser.NumericToken)]
                    groups[encoded(identity).decode()].append(row)
    for rows in groups.values():
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: encoded(_typed(row, parser.NumericToken)))
    return {
        "version_id": version_id, "document_id": document_id,
        "handover": {key: descriptor[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")},
        "source": source, "review": review, "selection": selection,
        "capture": {key: capture.get(key) for key in (
            "id", "captureSha256", "selectionSha256", "startedAt", "completedAt",
            "acquisition", "status", "collections", "requestGroups", "summary")},
        "pages": pages,
    }, groups


def compare_metadata(workspace, baseline_version_id, candidate_version_id, *, source_file, source_sha256):
    """Return full before/after context covered by the recurring review digest."""
    parser = _parser(Path(source_file), source_sha256)
    before, left = _edition(workspace, baseline_version_id, parser)
    after, right = _edition(workspace, candidate_version_id, parser)
    changes = []
    counts = {"added": 0, "removed": 0, "changed": 0, "unchanged": 0}
    for key in sorted(left.keys() | right.keys()):
        old, new = left.get(key, []), right.get(key, [])
        if _typed(old, parser.NumericToken) == _typed(new, parser.NumericToken):
            counts["unchanged"] += 1
            continue
        kind = "added" if not old else "removed" if not new else "changed"
        counts[kind] += 1
        identity = json.loads(key)
        changes.append({
            "change": kind, "kind": identity[0], "indicator_id": identity[1],
            "request_group": identity[2], "typed_record_id": identity[3],
            "before": old, "after": new,
            "before_numeric_tokens": _numbers(old, parser.NumericToken),
            "after_numeric_tokens": _numbers(new, parser.NumericToken),
        })
    selection_fields = ("sourceId", "countries", "indicators", "date")
    review_fields = ("title", "note", "columns", "excludedKeys", "choices", "includedObservations")
    selection_changes = {
        key: {"before": before["selection"].get(key), "after": after["selection"].get(key)}
        for key in sorted(before["selection"].keys() | after["selection"].keys())
        if before["selection"].get(key) != after["selection"].get(key)
    }
    review_changes = {
        key: {"before": before["review"].get(key), "after": after["review"].get(key)}
        for key in review_fields if before["review"].get(key) != after["review"].get(key)
    }
    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "baseline": before, "candidate": after,
        "same_selection": all(before["selection"].get(key) == after["selection"].get(key)
                              for key in selection_fields),
        "same_capture": before["source"]["captureSha256"] == after["source"]["captureSha256"],
        "selection_changes": selection_changes, "review_changes": review_changes,
        "provider_metadata_counts": counts, "provider_metadata_changes": changes,
        "numeric_representation": "Original numeric token strings with JSON-pointer type evidence; no float conversion.",
        "observation_comparison": "The original DatasetChanges comparison in the enclosing recurring review.",
    }

"""Named customer programmes around the original WorldBankRecurring operation.

Programme definitions and exact continuation JSON live in the original SQLite
workspace, so its existing portable snapshot carries their identities/history.
The separate coordinator sequences existing Analysis jobs without occupying
their single executor. Source acquisition and workbook/report writers stay with
their original owners.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import threading

from .errors import StateError
from .storage import digest
from .response_documents import document_path, validate_manifest, _delivery
from .worldbank_analysis import encoded, regular, write, MAX_DOCUMENT

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.worldbank-programmes.v1"
_CONTINUATIONS = (
    "operation.json", "intent.json", "recurring-intent.json",
    "recurring-review.json", "recurring-selection-intent.json",
    "workbook-proposal.json", "workbook-choice.json",
)
_NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}")
_ID = re.compile(r"[a-f0-9]{32}")


def _need(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise StateError("WORLDBANK_PROGRAMME_" + code)


def _name(value):
    _need(isinstance(value, str) and _NAME.fullmatch(value), "NAME_INVALID")
    return value


def _id(value):
    _need(isinstance(value, str) and _ID.fullmatch(value), "OPERATION_ID_INVALID")
    return value


def _now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def _revision(value):
    _need(type(value) is int and value >= 0, "EXPECTED_REVISION_REQUIRED")
    return value


def _page(before, limit, *, text=False):
    _need(type(limit) is int and 1 <= limit <= 100, "PAGE_INVALID")
    _need(before is None or (isinstance(before, str) if text else type(before) is int and before > 0),
          "PAGE_INVALID")


class WorldBankProgrammes:
    def __init__(self, workspace, *, core=None):
        self.workspace = workspace
        self.database = workspace.database
        self.core = Path(core).expanduser().absolute() if core else (
            Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "sf30-seller-sdk" / "worldbank" / "core.py")
        self._mutex = threading.RLock()
        self._closed = False
        self._active = None
        with self.database._connection() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_worldbank_programmes(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL)")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_worldbank_programme_history(name TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(name,revision))")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_worldbank_programme_requests(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL)")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_worldbank_operations(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL)")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sf_worldbank_operation_files(operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,raw TEXT NOT NULL,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(operation_id,name))")
            for row in db.execute("SELECT id,record FROM sf_worldbank_operations").fetchall():
                value = json.loads(row["record"])
                if value["status"] == "RUNNING":
                    value.update(status="INTERRUPTED", error="Continue this original operation with resume enabled.",
                                 updated_at=_now())
                    db.execute("UPDATE sf_worldbank_operations SET record=? WHERE id=?", (_json(value), row["id"]))
            db.commit()
        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="worldbank-programmes")

    def close(self):
        # AnalysisWorkspace must call this before marking itself closed and
        # without holding its job mutex: an active coordinator uses start().
        with self._mutex:
            self._closed = True
        self._executor.shutdown(wait=True)

    def _definition(self, db, name):
        row = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_worldbank_programmes WHERE name=?", (_name(name),)).fetchone()
        _need(row is not None, "NOT_FOUND")
        return json.loads(row[0])

    def definition(self, name):
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN")
            value = self._definition(db, name)
            history = [json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute(
                "SELECT record FROM sf_worldbank_programme_history WHERE name=? ORDER BY revision DESC", (name,))]
        page = self.history(name)
        return {**value, "history": history, "operations": page["operations"],
                "operation_next_before": page["next_before"]}

    def list(self, *, before=None, limit=50):
        _page(before, limit, text=True)
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT name,record FROM sf_worldbank_programmes WHERE (? IS NULL OR name>?) ORDER BY name LIMIT ?",
                              (before, before, limit + 1)).fetchall()
            recent = db.execute("SELECT record FROM sf_worldbank_operations ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 50").fetchall()
        source_page = self.sources()
        return {"schema": SCHEMA, "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity,
                "programmes": [json.loads(row["record"]) for row in rows[:limit]],
                "next_before": rows[limit-1]["name"] if len(rows) > limit else None,
                "sources": source_page["sources"], "source_next_before": source_page["next_before"],
                "operations": [self._public(json.loads(row[0])) for row in recent]}

    def history(self, name, *, before=None, limit=50):
        _page(before, limit)
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            self._definition(db, name)
            rows = db.execute("SELECT sequence,record FROM sf_worldbank_operations WHERE name=? AND (? IS NULL OR sequence<?) ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT ?",
                              (name, before, before, limit + 1)).fetchall()
        return {"operations": [self._public(json.loads(row["record"])) for row in rows[:limit]],
                "next_before": rows[limit-1]["sequence"] if len(rows) > limit else None}

    def _selected_source(self, source):
        _need(isinstance(source, dict), "SOURCE_REQUIRED")
        name, revision = _name(source.get("name")), source.get("revision")
        _need(type(revision) is int and revision > 0, "SOURCE_REVISION_REQUIRED")
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            retained = self.workspace.responses._source(db, name, revision)
        return self._document(retained, required=True)

    def _document(self, source, *, required=False):
        if source.get("input_kind") != "document":
            _need(not required, "RETAINED_WORLDBANK_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED")
            return None
        path = document_path(self.database.directory, source.get("document_id"))
        raw = regular(path, 1024 * 1024)
        _need(digest(raw) == source["document_id"], "DOCUMENT_CHANGED")
        manifest = validate_manifest(json.loads(raw))
        originals = {item["role"]: item for item in manifest["originals"]}
        if "original-worldbank-handover" not in originals:
            _need(not required, "RETAINED_WORLDBANK_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED")
            return None
        _need({"original-source.json", "original-review.json"} <= originals.keys(),
              "COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
        values = {}
        for role in ("original-source.json", "original-review.json"):
            with _delivery(path.parent, originals[role]).open() as stream:
                values[role] = json.loads(stream.read())
        handover = originals["original-worldbank-handover"]
        # Opening the original delivery checks its exact content-addressed bytes.
        if required:
            with _delivery(path.parent, handover).open():
                pass
        return {"name": source["name"], "revision": source["revision"], "title": manifest["title"],
                "document_id": source["document_id"],
                "handover": {"bytes": handover["bytes"], "sha256": handover["sha256"]},
                "source_metadata": values["original-source.json"],
                "review": values["original-review.json"],
                "_handover_path": str(path.parent / handover["path"])}

    def sources(self, *, before=None, limit=50):
        _page(before, limit)
        # Continue through unrelated retained documents; pagination is over the
        # source history, never a first-page assumption about World Bank rows.
        output, cursor = [], before
        while len(output) < limit:
            with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
                rows = db.execute("SELECT rowid AS sequence,record FROM sf_analysis_response_sources WHERE (? IS NULL OR rowid<?) ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT ?",
                                  (cursor, cursor, limit)).fetchall()
            if not rows:
                return {"sources": output, "next_before": None}
            for row in rows:
                cursor = row["sequence"]
                selected = self._document(json.loads(row["record"]))
                if selected:
                    output.append({key: value for key, value in selected.items() if not key.startswith("_")})
                if len(output) == limit:
                    return {"sources": output, "next_before": cursor}
            if len(rows) < limit:
                return {"sources": output, "next_before": None}
        return {"sources": output, "next_before": cursor}

    def save(self, name, payload):
        name, request_id = _name(name), _id(payload.get("id"))
        _need(name != "sources", "RESERVED_NAME")
        expected = _revision(payload.get("expected_revision"))
        spec = payload.get("definition")
        _need(isinstance(spec, dict), "DEFINITION_REQUIRED")
        title = spec.get("title")
        _need(isinstance(title, str) and title.strip() and len(title) <= 200, "TITLE_REQUIRED")
        definition = {key: _name(spec.get(key)) for key in ("view", "report", "workbook")}
        keys = spec.get("keys")
        _need(isinstance(keys, list) and 1 <= len(keys) <= 16 and
              all(isinstance(key, str) and key and len(key) <= 200 for key in keys) and
              len(keys) == len(set(keys)), "EXPLICIT_SOURCE_KEYS_REQUIRED")
        prefix = spec.get("prefix", "worldbank")
        _need(isinstance(prefix, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,20}", prefix), "PREFIX_INVALID")
        definition.update(title=title, keys=keys, prefix=prefix)
        request_sha = digest(encoded({"name": name, "expected_revision": expected, "definition": definition}))
        with self._mutex, self.database._connection() as db:
            _need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            old = db.execute("SELECT sha256,record FROM sf_worldbank_programme_requests WHERE id=?", (request_id,)).fetchone()
            if old:
                _need(old["sha256"] == request_sha, "SAVE_ID_REUSED")
                return json.loads(old["record"])
            row = db.execute("SELECT revision FROM sf_worldbank_programmes WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
            _need((row[0] if row else 0) == expected, "DEFINITION_CHANGED")
            # Resolve actual customer identities, without saving generated SQL
            # or rewriting their report and workbook definitions.
            current = self.workspace.database.current(definition["view"])
            _need(current["version"] is not None, "EXISTING_VIEW_REQUIRED")
            self.workspace.reports.definition(definition["report"])
            self.workspace.workbooks.definition(definition["workbook"])
            value = {"name": name, "revision": expected + 1, "definition": definition,
                     "definition_sha256": digest(encoded(definition)), "saved_at": _now()}
            raw = _json(value)
            db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_worldbank_programmes VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET revision=excluded.revision,record=excluded.record",
                       (name, value["revision"], raw))
            db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_worldbank_programme_history VALUES(?,?,?)", (name, value["revision"], raw))
            db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_worldbank_programme_requests VALUES(?,?,?)", (request_id, request_sha, raw))
            db.commit()
        return value

    def _operation(self, name, operation_id):
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT name,record FROM sf_worldbank_operations WHERE id=?", (_id(operation_id),)).fetchone()
        _need(row is not None and row["name"] == _name(name), "OPERATION_NOT_FOUND")
        return json.loads(row["record"])

    def _store(self, value):
        value["updated_at"] = _now()
        with self.database._connection() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE sf_worldbank_operations SET record=? WHERE id=?", (_json(value), value["operation_id"]))

    def _public(self, value):
        return {key: item for key, item in value.items() if key not in ("core",)}

    def _files(self, operation_id):
        with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT name,raw,sha256 FROM sf_worldbank_operation_files WHERE operation_id=?", (operation_id,)).fetchall()
        result = {}
        for row in rows:
            _need(row["name"] in _CONTINUATIONS and digest(row["raw"].encode()) == row["sha256"],
                  "CONTINUATION_CHANGED")
            result[row["name"]] = row["raw"]
        return result

    def _accepted_binding(self, value):
        """Resolve accepted business outputs independently of ZIP assembly."""
        accepted_id = value.get("accepted_operation_id", value["operation_id"])
        files = self._files(accepted_id)
        if not {"operation.json", "recurring-review.json"} <= files.keys():
            return None
        original = json.loads(files["operation.json"])
        review = json.loads(files["recurring-review.json"])
        needed = {"recurring_selection", "recurring_workbook", "publication", "version_id", "source", "view"}
        if not needed <= original.keys() or not original.get("jobs", {}).get("WORKBOOK"):
            return None
        from .worldbank_recurring import review_digest
        _need(original["operation_id"] == accepted_id and review["operation_id"] == accepted_id and
              review["workspace_id"] == self.workspace.identity and
              review["review_sha256"] == review_digest(review), "ACCEPTED_REVIEW_CHANGED")
        selected = self.workspace.changes.page(review["comparison"]["id"], limit=1)
        _need(selected["selection"] == original["recurring_selection"] and
              selected["report"]["result_sha256"] == review["comparison"]["result_sha256"],
              "ACCEPTED_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        version_id = original["version_id"]
        _need(version_id == review["candidate_version_id"] ==
              original["recurring_selection"]["activation"]["version"]["version_id"],
              "ACCEPTED_VERSION_CHANGED")
        self.workspace.database.version(version_id)
        publication = original["publication"]
        self.workspace.workbooks.source({"kind": "report", "id": publication["id"],
                                         "section": 0, "sha256": publication["sha256"]})
        job_id = original["jobs"]["WORKBOOK"][-1]["id"]
        try:
            workbook = self.workspace.job(job_id)
        except StateError as error:
            if (getattr(error, "code", None) or str(error)) == "ANALYSIS_JOB_NOT_FOUND":
                # The original adapter saves its attempt before start() commits
                # the native job. Preserve that resumable preparation boundary.
                return None
            raise
        if workbook["status"] != "COMPLETE":
            return None
        _need(workbook["kind"] == "workbook" and
              all(workbook["request"][key] == original["recurring_workbook"][key]
                  for key in ("name", "revision", "definition_sha256")), "ACCEPTED_WORKBOOK_CHANGED")
        binding = {"operation_id": accepted_id, "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity,
                   "review_sha256": review["review_sha256"], "version_id": version_id,
                   "source": original["source"], "view": original["view"], "publication": publication,
                   "selection_sha256": selected["selection_sha256"],
                   "workbook": {"job_id": job_id, "manifest_sha256": workbook["result"]["manifest_sha256"],
                                "definition": original["recurring_workbook"]}}
        return {**binding, "binding_sha256": digest(encoded(binding))}

    def status(self, name, operation_id):
        value = self._public(self._operation(name, operation_id))
        files = self._files(operation_id)
        if "recurring-review.json" in files:
            value["review"] = json.loads(files["recurring-review.json"])
        if "workbook-proposal.json" in files:
            value["proposal"] = json.loads(files["workbook-proposal.json"])
        value["accepted_edition"] = self._accepted_binding(value)
        value["can_reopen"] = value["accepted_edition"] is not None and value["status"] in ("ERROR", "INTERRUPTED", "COMPLETE")
        if value["status"] == "COMPLETE":
            root = self.database.directory / "worldbank-analysis" / operation_id / "delivery"
            value["downloads"] = [{**item, "available": (root / item["filename"]).is_file()}
                                  for item in value["result"]["files"]]
        return value

    def review(self, name, operation_id):
        value = self.status(name, operation_id)
        _need("review" in value, "REVIEW_NOT_READY")
        return value["review"]

    def prepare(self, name, payload):
        name, operation_id = _name(name), _id(payload.get("id"))
        expected = _revision(payload.get("expected_revision"))
        source = payload.get("source")
        _need(isinstance(source, dict), "SOURCE_REQUIRED")
        request = {"id": operation_id, "expected_revision": expected,
                   "source": {"name": _name(source.get("name")), "revision": source.get("revision")}}
        resume = payload.get("resume", False)
        _need(type(resume) is bool, "RESUME_INVALID")
        with self._mutex:
            _need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
                old = db.execute("SELECT name,record FROM sf_worldbank_operations WHERE id=?", (operation_id,)).fetchone()
                definition = self._definition(db, name)
            if old:
                _need(old["name"] == name, "OPERATION_ID_REUSED")
                value = json.loads(old["record"])
                _need(value["prepare_request"] == request, "OPERATION_ID_REUSED")
                if value["status"] in ("RUNNING", "REVIEW_READY", "WORKBOOK_COLUMN_CHOICES_REQUIRED", "COMPLETE"):
                    return self.status(name, operation_id)
                _need(value["action"] == "prepare" and resume, "ORIGINAL_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED")
            else:
                _need(definition["revision"] == expected, "DEFINITION_CHANGED")
                _need(self._active is None, "BUSY")
                selected = self._selected_source(request["source"])
                # Core comes from the installed original package/explicit launch
                # configuration. A browser-selected source never supplies code.
                core = self.core.resolve(strict=True)
                _need(core.name == "core.py", "ORIGINAL_CORE_REQUIRED")
                core_identity = {"core_sha256": digest(regular(core)),
                                 "source_sha256": digest(regular(core.parent / "source.py"))}
                value = {"schema": SCHEMA, "name": name, "operation_id": operation_id,
                         "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity, "programme": definition,
                         "prepare_request": request, "publish_request": None,
                         "source": {k: v for k, v in selected.items() if not k.startswith("_")},
                         "core": core_identity, "status": "RUNNING", "phase": "SOURCE_REVIEW",
                         "action": "prepare", "created_at": _now(), "updated_at": _now(), "error": None}
                with self.database._connection() as db:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_worldbank_operations(id,name,record) VALUES(?,?,?)",
                               (operation_id, name, _json(value)))
            self._launch(value, "prepare", resume)
        return self.status(name, operation_id)

    def publish(self, name, payload):
        operation_id = _id(payload.get("id"))
        note = payload.get("note")
        _need(isinstance(note, str) and note.strip() and len(note.encode()) <= 8000, "REVIEW_NOTE_REQUIRED")
        selected = payload.get("review_sha256")
        _need(isinstance(selected, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", selected), "REVIEW_DIGEST_REQUIRED")
        columns = payload.get("columns")
        _need(columns is None or isinstance(columns, dict), "COLUMNS_INVALID")
        resume = payload.get("resume", False)
        _need(type(resume) is bool, "RESUME_INVALID")
        request = {"id": operation_id, "review_sha256": selected, "note": note, "columns": columns}
        with self._mutex:
            _need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            value = self._operation(name, operation_id)
            review = self.review(name, operation_id)
            _need(review["review_sha256"] == selected, "REVIEW_CHANGED")
            previous = value.get("publish_request")
            if previous:
                _need(all(previous[key] == request[key] for key in ("id", "review_sha256", "note")),
                      "SELECTION_INTENT_CHANGED")
            if value["status"] in ("RUNNING", "COMPLETE"):
                _need(previous == request, "PUBLISH_ID_REUSED")
                return self.status(name, operation_id)
            _need(value["status"] in ("REVIEW_READY", "WORKBOOK_COLUMN_CHOICES_REQUIRED", "ERROR", "INTERRUPTED"),
                  "REVIEW_NOT_READY")
            if value["status"] in ("ERROR", "INTERRUPTED"):
                _need(value["action"] == "publish" and resume, "ORIGINAL_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED")
            value["publish_request"] = request
            self._launch(value, "publish", resume)
        return self.status(name, operation_id)

    def reopen(self, name, payload):
        """Create a fresh portable delivery of an accepted immutable edition.

        Its new snapshot includes later customer edits. The original report
        publication/workbook build are reused, and the parent delivery remains
        a distinct immutable operation. This avoids nested old workspace ZIPs.
        """
        name, operation_id = _name(name), _id(payload.get("id"))
        parent_id = _id(payload.get("operation_id"))
        _need(operation_id != parent_id, "NEW_DELIVERY_ID_REQUIRED")
        resume = payload.get("resume", False)
        _need(type(resume) is bool, "RESUME_INVALID")
        request = {"id": operation_id, "operation_id": parent_id}
        with self._mutex:
            _need(not self._closed, "CLOSED")
            with self.database._connection(readonly=True) as db:
                old = db.execute("SELECT name,record FROM sf_worldbank_operations WHERE id=?", (operation_id,)).fetchone()
            if old:
                value = json.loads(old["record"])
                _need(old["name"] == name and value.get("reopen_request") == request, "OPERATION_ID_REUSED")
                if value["status"] in ("RUNNING", "COMPLETE"):
                    return self.status(name, operation_id)
                _need(resume and value["action"] == "reopen", "ORIGINAL_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED")
            else:
                _need(self._active is None, "BUSY")
                parent = self._operation(name, parent_id)
                _need(parent["status"] in ("ERROR", "INTERRUPTED", "COMPLETE"), "ACCEPTED_EDITION_REQUIRED")
                # Reopening another delivered copy resolves the actual original
                # accepted source/review, without rewriting either parent.
                accepted_id = parent.get("accepted_operation_id", parent_id)
                accepted = self._operation(name, accepted_id)
                binding = self._accepted_binding(accepted)
                _need(binding is not None and accepted["status"] in ("ERROR", "INTERRUPTED", "COMPLETE"),
                      "ACCEPTED_EDITION_REQUIRED")
                value = {"schema": SCHEMA, "name": name, "operation_id": operation_id,
                         "workspace_id": self.workspace.identity, "programme": accepted["programme"],
                         "prepare_request": None, "publish_request": None, "reopen_request": request,
                         "parent_operation_id": parent_id, "accepted_operation_id": accepted_id,
                         "accepted_binding_sha256": binding["binding_sha256"],
                         "source": accepted["source"], "core": accepted["core"],
                         "status": "RUNNING", "phase": "PORTABLE_DELIVERY", "action": "reopen",
                         "created_at": _now(), "updated_at": _now(), "error": None}
                with self.database._connection() as db:
                    db.execute("INSERT INTO sf_worldbank_operations(id,name,record) VALUES(?,?,?)",
                               (operation_id, name, _json(value)))
            self._launch(value, "reopen", resume)
        return self.status(name, operation_id)

    def _reopen_delivery(self, current, value, *, resume):
        from .worldbank_analysis import describe
        accepted = self._operation(value["name"], value["accepted_operation_id"])
        binding = self._accepted_binding(accepted)
        _need(binding is not None and binding["binding_sha256"] == value["accepted_binding_sha256"],
              "ACCEPTED_EDITION_CHANGED")
        files = self._files(value["accepted_operation_id"])
        original = json.loads(files["operation.json"])
        review = json.loads(files["recurring-review.json"])
        _need(original["operation_id"] == accepted["operation_id"], "ORIGINAL_OPERATION_CHANGED")
        # The original recurring delivery writer renders its guide from these
        # exact accepted inputs. A new linked delivery has its own operation
        # record but must carry the unchanged guide context from its parent.
        # Retain both before starting any export so a restored receiver does
        # not finish its archive and then fail on a producer-only file path.
        for filename in ("recurring-review.json", "workbook-proposal.json"):
            _need(filename in files, "ACCEPTED_GUIDE_INPUT_MISSING")
            write(current.directory / filename, files[filename].encode("utf-8"), exact=True)
        for key in ("source", "view", "publication", "version_id"):
            current.record[key] = original[key]
        current.record["parent_operation_id"] = value["parent_operation_id"]
        current.record["accepted_operation_id"] = value["accepted_operation_id"]
        current.record["accepted_binding_sha256"] = value["accepted_binding_sha256"]
        current.save()
        workbook = self.workspace.job(binding["workbook"]["job_id"])
        _need(workbook["status"] == "COMPLETE" and
              workbook["result"]["manifest_sha256"] == binding["workbook"]["manifest_sha256"],
              "ACCEPTED_WORKBOOK_CHANGED")
        extra = []
        destination = current.directory / "delivery"
        for format in ("json", "csv"):
            export = current.job(self.workspace, "CHANGES_" + format.upper(), "change-export", {
                "comparison_id": review["comparison"]["id"],
                "result_sha256": review["comparison"]["result_sha256"],
                "selection_sha256": binding["selection_sha256"], "format": format}, resume=resume)
            path, descriptor = self.workspace.change_export_file(export["id"])
            body = regular(path, 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
            _need(len(body) == descriptor["bytes"] and digest(body) == descriptor["sha256"],
                  "ACCEPTED_COMPARISON_CHANGED")
            target = destination / ("WorldBank_Source_Changes." + format)
            write(target, body, exact=True)
            extra.append(describe(target))
        # This receipt binds the original accepted comparison/report/workbook
        # and the separately requested new snapshot, without copying an old ZIP.
        receipt = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": value["operation_id"],
            "parent_operation_id": value["parent_operation_id"],
            "accepted_operation_id": value["accepted_operation_id"],
            "accepted_binding_sha256": value["accepted_binding_sha256"],
            "review_sha256": review["review_sha256"],
            "selection": original["recurring_selection"],
            "customer_report": {"name": review["target"]["report"],
                                "revision": review["report"]["definition"]["revision"],
                                "sha256": review["report"]["sha256"]},
            "customer_workbook": original["recurring_workbook"],
            "snapshot": "Current customer workspace; accepted report and workbook editions remain unchanged.",
        }
        target = destination / "WorldBank_Recurring_Selection.json"
        write(target, encoded(receipt), exact=True)
        extra.append(describe(target))
        publication = original["publication"]
        return current._deliver(
            self.workspace, review["source_metadata"], review["original_review"],
            review["source"]["observations"],
            self.workspace.database.version(binding["version_id"]),
            publication, publication["sha256"], workbook, resume=resume, extra_files=extra)

    def _launch(self, value, action, resume):
        _need(self._active is None, "BUSY")
        self._active = value["operation_id"]
        value.update(status="RUNNING", action=action, error=None)
        try:
            self._store(value)
            self._executor.submit(self._run, value["name"], value["operation_id"], action, resume)
        except BaseException:
            self._active = None
            value.update(status="INTERRUPTED", error="Continue the retained operation.")
            self._store(value)
            raise

    def _capture(self, operation_id, directory):
        contents = []
        for name in _CONTINUATIONS:
            path = directory / name
            if path.exists():
                raw = regular(path, MAX_DOCUMENT).decode("utf-8")
                json.loads(raw)
                contents.append((operation_id, name, raw, digest(raw.encode())))
        with self.database._connection() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            db.executemany("INSERT INTO sf_worldbank_operation_files VALUES(?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(operation_id,name) DO UPDATE SET raw=excluded.raw,sha256=excluded.sha256", contents)
            db.commit()

    def _run(self, name, operation_id, action, resume):
        # Import lazily: the original engine itself imports AnalysisWorkspace.
        current = None
        try:
            from .worldbank_recurring import WorldBankRecurring
            value = self._operation(name, operation_id)
            _need(value["workspace_id"] == self.workspace.identity, "WORKSPACE_CHANGED")
            core = None
            if action != "reopen":
                core = self.core.resolve(strict=True)
                _need(value["core"] == {"core_sha256": digest(regular(core)),
                                       "source_sha256": digest(regular(core.parent / "source.py"))},
                      "ORIGINAL_CORE_CHANGED")
            root = self.database.directory / "worldbank-analysis" / operation_id
            for filename, raw in self._files(operation_id).items():
                # Original immutable intents/review retain exact bytes, even
                # after a workspace restore; never rehash a rewritten review.
                path = root / filename
                if path.exists():
                    local = regular(path, MAX_DOCUMENT).decode("utf-8")
                    json.loads(local)
                    if filename not in ("operation.json", "workbook-proposal.json"):
                        _need(local == raw, "LOCAL_CONTINUATION_CHANGED")
                    # Mutable original engine records can have advanced before
                    # a process stopped between the file write and DB mirror.
                    # Keep their actual progress and checkpoint it below.
                else:
                    write(path, raw.encode(), exact=True)

            def progress(event):
                state = self._operation(name, operation_id)
                state["phase"] = event.get("phase", state["phase"])
                state["progress"] = event
                self._store(state)
                if current is not None:
                    self._capture(operation_id, current.directory)

            current = WorldBankRecurring(self.database.directory, operation_id=operation_id,
                                         progress=progress, active_workspace=self.workspace)
            original_save = current.save

            def save():
                original_save()
                self._capture(operation_id, current.directory)

            current.save = save
            if action == "prepare":
                selected = self._selected_source(value["prepare_request"]["source"])
                _need(selected["handover"] == value["source"]["handover"] and
                      selected["document_id"] == value["source"]["document_id"], "SOURCE_CHANGED")
                definition = value["programme"]["definition"]
                result = current.review(selected["_handover_path"], core,
                                        view=definition["view"], report=definition["report"],
                                        workbook=definition["workbook"], keys=definition["keys"],
                                        prefix=definition["prefix"], resume=resume)
                status = "REVIEW_READY"
            elif action == "reopen":
                result = self._reopen_delivery(current, value, resume=resume)
                status = "COMPLETE"
            else:
                request = value["publish_request"]
                result = current.refresh(request["review_sha256"], note=request["note"],
                                         columns=request["columns"], resume=resume)
                status = result.get("status", "COMPLETE")
            self._capture(operation_id, current.directory)
            state = self._operation(name, operation_id)
            state.update(status=status, result=result, error=None)
            self._store(state)
        except Exception as error:
            state = self._operation(name, operation_id)
            state.update(status="ERROR", error=str(error))
            self._store(state)
        finally:
            try:
                if current is not None:
                    try:
                        self._capture(operation_id, current.directory)
                    except Exception as error:
                        state = self._operation(name, operation_id)
                        state.update(status="ERROR", error="Continuation checkpoint: " + str(error))
                        self._store(state)
            finally:
                with self._mutex:
                    if self._active == operation_id:
                        self._active = None

    def download(self, name, operation_id, filename):
        value = self._operation(name, operation_id)
        _need(value["status"] == "COMPLETE", "DELIVERY_NOT_COMPLETE")
        record = next((item for item in value["result"]["files"] if item["filename"] == filename), None)
        _need(record is not None and Path(filename).name == filename, "FILE_NOT_FOUND")
        path = self.database.directory / "worldbank-analysis" / operation_id / "delivery" / filename
        # The existing HTTP _file_reply verifies and streams one open
        # descriptor; avoid a second whole-archive read in this adapter.
        return path, {**record, "name": filename,
                      "mime": "application/zip" if filename.endswith(".zip") else
                                      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" if filename.endswith(".xlsx") else
                                      "application/json" if filename.endswith(".json") else
                                      "text/html; charset=utf-8" if filename.endswith(".html") else
                                      "text/plain; charset=utf-8"}

"""Refresh an approved World Bank edition in the customer's original Analysis workspace.

The existing importer, comparison, report, workbook-refresh and archive engines
own all data and transitions. This adapter preserves customer definitions and
retains one original operation across review, selection and complete delivery.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
import fcntl
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import zipfile

from .analysis_workspace import AnalysisWorkspace
from .errors import BuyerError
from .storage import private_directory
from .worldbank_metadata import compare_metadata
from .worldbank_analysis import WorldBankAnalysis, encoded, sha, regular, write, describe, require, MAX_DOCUMENT

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.worldbank-recurring-review.v1"
DEFAULT_KEYS = ["source_id", "country_id", "country_iso3", "indicator_id", "period"]


def review_digest(value):
    return sha(encoded({key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != "review_sha256"}))


class WorldBankRecurring(WorldBankAnalysis):
    def review(self, handover, core, *, view, report, workbook, keys=None, prefix="worldbank", resume=False):
        for name in (view, report, workbook):
            require(isinstance(name, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}", name),
                    "Select the actual saved customer view, report and workbook names.")
        if keys is None:
            original_intent = self.directory / "recurring-intent.json"
            if original_intent.exists():
                retained_intent = json.loads(regular(original_intent, MAX_DOCUMENT))
                require(retained_intent.get("schema") == SCHEMA and
                        retained_intent.get("operation_id") == self.operation_id and
                        all(retained_intent.get(field) == value for field, value in (
                            ("view", view), ("report", report), ("workbook", workbook))),
                        "Continue the original recurring customer and comparison keys.")
                keys = retained_intent["keys"]
            else:
                keys = DEFAULT_KEYS
        require(isinstance(keys, list) and 1 <= len(keys) <= 16 and
                all(isinstance(key, str) for key in keys) and len(keys) == len(set(keys)),
                "Supply one to sixteen distinct original comparison key columns.")
        target = {"schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": self.operation_id,
                  "view": view, "report": report, "workbook": workbook, "keys": keys}
        write(self.directory / "recurring-intent.json", encoded(target), exact=True)
        self.target = target
        result = self.prepare(handover, core, prefix=prefix, resume=resume)
        if result.get("schema") == SCHEMA:
            return result
        received = json.loads(regular(self.directory / "recurring-review.json", MAX_DOCUMENT))
        require(received.get("review_sha256") == review_digest(received) and
                received.get("target") == target, "Continue the original completed recurring review.")
        return received

    def _prepare_analysis(self, workspace, document, name, source, review,
                          rows, columns, selected_recipes, max_rows, *, resume):
        # The original importer retains the complete handover and typed rows.
        # A distinct source name preserves earlier documents. The customer view
        # is selected only by the original reviewed comparison in refresh().
        registered = workspace.responses.register(name, "document", manifest=document / "source.json")
        preview = self.job(workspace, "SOURCE_PREVIEW", "response-preview", {
            "source": name, "source_revision": registered["revision"],
            "mapping": {"collection": "/observations", "sse_data": "text",
                        "columns": [{"name": column, "pointer": "/" + column,
                                     "type": "native", "missing": "error"} for column in columns]}},
            resume=resume)
        imported = self.job(workspace, "SOURCE_IMPORT", "response-import", {
            "preview_id": preview["id"], "preview_sha256": preview["result"]["preview_sha256"],
            "allow_incomplete": False}, resume=resume)
        version = imported["result"]["version"]
        require(version["row_count"] == len(rows), "The reviewed row count changed on import.")
        retained = self.directory / "recurring-review.json"
        if retained.exists():
            received = json.loads(regular(retained, MAX_DOCUMENT))
            require(received.get("review_sha256") == review_digest(received) and
                    received.get("workspace_id") == workspace.identity and
                    received.get("target") == self.target and
                    received.get("candidate_version_id") == version["version_id"],
                    "Continue the complete original recurring review.")
            return received

        baseline = workspace.database.current(self.target["view"])
        require(baseline["version"] is not None, "Select an existing customer view.")
        report = workspace.reports.definition(self.target["report"])
        workbook = workspace.workbooks.definition(self.target["workbook"])
        # Resolve every original worksheet before making a source selection.
        # This also verifies the retained full report/query-export sources.
        refresh = workspace.workbooks.refresh
        related = []
        for index, sheet in enumerate(workbook["definition"]["sheets"]):
            lineage = refresh._lineage(sheet["source"])
            if lineage.get("kind") == "report" and lineage["report_name"] == self.target["report"]:
                sections = [section["ordinal"] for section in report["definition"]["sections"]
                            if section["query_name"] == lineage["query_name"]]
                matches = sections if len(lineage["query_sections"]) == len(sections) == 1 else [
                    ordinal for ordinal in sections if ordinal == lineage["section"]]
